title: Unified Communications Engineer
description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Unified Communications Engineer is responsible for the configuration, operation, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise voice and collaboration services across cloud, hybrid, and data center environments. The role contributes technical expertise to infrastructure initiatives and helps maintain secure, resilient, and highly available communication services through integration, troubleshooting, automation, lifecycle management, documentation, and disaster recovery
  
  
**Job Description**

* Design, configure, monitor, administer, and continuously improve Unified Communications services across cloud, hybrid, and data center environments.
* Contribute technical expertise to infrastructure projects involving voice, collaboration, monitoring, security, service continuity, and capacity planning.
* Support the engineering and administration of Microsoft Teams Phone, Cisco CUCM, Ribbon SBCs, voice gateways, provider connectivity, dial plans, call routing, backups, restoration, and disaster recovery.
* Configure and maintain SIP and, where applicable, legacy H.323 integrations, applying networking and QoS principles to support reliable voice and video services.
* Perform system health checks, availability monitoring, performance analysis, optimization, and capacity planning, identifying risks and recommending corrective actions.
* Participate in complex incident diagnosis, root-cause analysis, major-problem resolution, and post-incident reviews in coordination with internal teams and vendors.
* Plan and implement upgrades, migrations, patches, and configuration changes, assessing technical risk, compatibility, rollback, and operational impact.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and Azure Automation workflows that improve reliability, consistency, efficiency, and control.
* Provide technical support for meeting-room design, audiovisual integration, smart scheduling, monitoring, and complex troubleshooting.
* Maintain architecture records, standards, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, and support knowledge.
* Support technical evaluations, quotations, supplier assessments, purchase-order input, licensing and renewal activities, and validation of equipment and service requirements.
* Participate in planned maintenance windows, after-hours escalation, and global or regional service coverage as required.
* Contribute to technical standards, proofs of concept, lifecycle roadmaps, and adoption of relevant industry practices while sharing knowledge with less-experienced engineers.

**The Services In Scope Include**

* Microsoft Teams Phone and associated Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities.
* Cisco Unified Communications Manager, voice gateways, and legacy voice integrations.
* Session Border Controllers, PSTN and telecom provider connectivity, SIP trunks, dial plans, call routing, and related voice protocols.

Meeting-room and audiovisual collaboration technologies, monitoring, automation, documentation, backup, and disaster recovery.
  
  
**Must Have**
You are meant for this job if:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years of relevant experience in Unified Communications, collaboration, voice, or a closely related infrastructure field, including participation in technical initiatives.
* Relevant Microsoft or cloud certification, such as Azure Administrator Associate, MS-721, or equivalent, is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of Microsoft Teams Phone, Cisco CUCM, Ribbon SBCs, voice gateways, dial plans, call routing, PSTN connectivity, and SIP/H.323 protocols.
* Good understanding of networking and infrastructure concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, VPN, Active Directory, Group Policy, QoS, server operating systems, and virtualization.
* Experience with PowerShell and automation for administration, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
* Experience troubleshooting incidents, performing root-cause analysis, implementing changes and upgrades, and maintaining technical documentation and operating procedures.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with attention to detail and fluency in English.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with meeting-room and audiovisual technologies, smart scheduling solutions, and global enterprise service delivery.
* Familiarity with Azure Automation, ITIL practices, Lean ways of working, change management, post-incident reviews, and technology evaluation.
* Relevant voice or collaboration certification, such as CCNP Collaboration, SBC Edge certification, or equivalent, is preferred.

**Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.**

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.
  
  
**This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.**
Plume's Core Engineering team builds the open-standards firmware foundation of our platform across RDK-B, prplOS and OpenWRT and OpenSync. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own the controller based broadband router firmware stack end to end: architecture, design, implementation, upstreaming
  
  
You will be the technical lead for various features like device management, network management, Wi-Fi and multi-AP mesh features such as backhaul management and steering, onboarding and metrics etc.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own architecture and design for various CPE features like EasyMesh, Wi-Fi Optimization, remote and local controller over standard SDK platforms like RDK-B, PrplOS, OpenWRT and OpenSync. This includes deep Wi-Fi sub-system management like backhaul link tracking, standard and hitless (make-before-break) backhaul steering, backhaul STA policies, and AP/STA metrics.
* Break large features into sequenced, reviewable work. Write design documents, feature matrices and validation reports that both engineers and program stakeholders can use.
* Maintain Plume's RDK-B Yocto layer and patch framework. Lead quarterly rebases onto new RDK-B releases and keep reference builds healthy on gateway and extender targets.
* Close gaps in TR-181 data models exposed through USP (obuspa) and UBus, RBus, including Wi-Fi DataElements, DHCP and DNS.
* Deliver onboarding flows: WPS, Wi-Fi EasyConnect (DPP) and backhaul onboarding, with WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz and Wi-Fi 7 MLO support.
* Triage and fix Alpha, Beta and GA blockers: mesh instability, IPv6 dual-stack and RA behavior, routing, firmware upgrade failures, and CPU and memory regressions. Back each fix with measured before/after data.
* Upstream fixes to opensource community like RDK Central, PrplOS, OpenWRT and evaluate competing community contributions against our own implementation.
* Contribute to cross-platform work on prplOS/prplMesh and OpenSync, including porting spikes and architecture comparisons.
* Review code and mentor engineers. Work closely with QA, program management and architects in other regions.

**What You'll Bring**

* 10+ years building embedded Linux or networking firmware, with 4+ years on Wi-Fi or broadband CPE software.
* Strong C and C++ on Linux user space, plus shell scripting. Comfortable debugging on target with gdb, core dumps, /proc and packet captures.
* Hands-on RDK-B (e.g. CCSP components, RBus, OneWifi, WebConfig, and Yocto/BitBake builds) and PrplOS experiences
* Deep 802.11 knowledge: hostapd and wpa\_supplicant, 802.11k/v/r and BTM, WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz, MLO.
* Working knowledge of EasyMesh and IEEE 1905.1: topology discovery, TLVs, controller/agent state machines and backhaul.
* TR-181 and USP/TR-369. TR-069 experience is a plus.
* Solid IP networking: IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, DHCPv4/v6, router advertisements, routing, netfilter/iptables and QoS.
* A track record of taking features from spike to GA, with written designs that others build from.
* Fluent in Git and GitHub pull-request workflows, quilt-style patch management and Jenkins CI.

**About Plume**
As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.
  
  
Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume’s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.
  
  
Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

description:

**EY GDS – APIGEE Platform Architect Position**
Over the last decade, API-led connectivity, cloud-native modernization and digital transformation have become critical for ensuring scalability, security and resilience across enterprise ecosystems. To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission-critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Manager APIGEE Platform Architect supporting large-scale API management environments across hybrid and multi-cloud deployments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.

* Strong decision-making and technical leadership capabilities

* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services

title: Principal Consultant - System Platform
description:

**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Principal Consultant
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**The job**
We are seeking a highly accomplished and experienced
**Principal Consultant – Unified Operations Center (UOC)**
to lead the architecture, strategy, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio. This role will serve as the technical authority for defining solution architectures, driving technology strategy, and delivering business-critical industrial solutions for global customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in
**AVEVA System Platform, Unified Operations Center (UOC), industrial system architectures, SCADA/HMI solutions, enterprise integration, cloud-enabled industrial platforms, and OT-IT convergence**
. The Principal Consultant will be responsible for defining enterprise solution blueprints, establishing architecture and engineering standards, leading technical governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solutions across complex industrial environments.
  
  
As a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, the Principal Consultant will collaborate with business leaders, enterprise architects, project managers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to shape digital transformation initiatives across industries including
**Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Utilities, Water, and Power**
. The role also includes driving pre-sales and solution consulting activities, mentoring senior consultants and engineering teams, establishing technical best practices and reusable frameworks, and influencing the organization's technology roadmap while ensuring successful project execution and long-term customer success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, and technical governance of enterprise-scale Unified Operations Center (UOC) and Industrial Automation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio.
* Define enterprise solution blueprints, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives and digital transformation strategies.
* Own the preparation, review, and approval of High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), Solution Design Documents (SDD), and architecture standards.
* Define and govern deployment architectures across the AVEVA ecosystem, including:

+ Galaxy Repository
+ Application Object Servers
+ AVEVA Historian
+ Communication Drivers
+ AVEVA OMI
+ Alarm Servers
+ Application Servers
+ License Manager
+ Identity Manager

* Establish architecture standards, engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, and governance models to ensure consistency across multiple projects and delivery teams.
* Design and review High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, failover, backup, and business continuity strategies for mission-critical industrial applications.
* Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and multi-site deployments.
* Define enterprise system architectures encompassing network topology, virtualization, cloud/hybrid deployments, cybersecurity, identity management, and OT-IT integration.
* Provide technical leadership in solution reviews, architecture governance, risk assessments, and design assurance to ensure compliance with customer standards, AVEVA best practices, and industry regulations.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architecture improvements to enhance system scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders, enterprise architects, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop innovative, future-ready solutions that meet both business and operational objectives.
* Serve as the technical authority for complex solution design decisions, architecture escalations, and strategic technology direction across multiple projects and customer engagements.

**Essential Requirements**
**Non-Technical**

* Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, executive stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead customer workshops, solution discussions, architecture reviews, and executive presentations.
* Proven leadership, mentoring, and coaching skills with experience guiding technical teams and driving engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage complex technical and business challenges.
* Ability and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, solution workshops, architecture reviews, commissioning, and project delivery.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Project.

**Technical**

* 12–18 years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, and Digital Transformation, with extensive hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions using the AVEVA portfolio.
* Recognized subject matter expert in the AVEVA product suite, including System Platform, Operations Control (UOC), OMI, Historian, Communication Drivers, Reports, Application Server, License Manager, and Identity Manager.
* Extensive experience in defining enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and deployment strategies for large-scale AVEVA System Platform implementations.
* Proven experience leading Unified Operations Center (UOC) / AVEVA Operations Control programs across multiple sites, business units, or geographically distributed facilities.
* Strong expertise in designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient industrial automation architectures, including redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), and failover strategies.
* Extensive experience in AVEVA System Platform object modeling, template development, standardization, governance, and reusable engineering frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA System Platform scripting, .NET Framework integration, I/O mapping, and device integration.
* Hands-on experience developing high-performance HMI applications, dashboards, and visualizations using AVEVA OMI, ArchestrA Graphics, and InTouch.
* Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols, including OPC DA, OPC UA, MQTT, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Extensive experience integrating AVEVA System Platform with enterprise applications such as SAP, MES, ERP systems, SQL Server, REST APIs, and other business applications.
* Strong knowledge of relational database design, SQL Server, data integration, and industrial data management.
* Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and enterprise reporting solutions is desirable.
* Proven experience in solution sizing, infrastructure planning, system capacity assessment, and performance optimization for enterprise deployments.
* Strong understanding of distributed system architecture, client/server optimization, load balancing, virtualization, redundancy, and high-availability deployments.
* Experience with cloud-enabled industrial solutions, including AVEVA CONNECT, Microsoft Azure, hybrid architectures, and OT-IT convergence is highly desirable.
* Proven experience leading technical governance, architecture reviews, design approvals, and engineering quality assurance across multiple projects.
* Strong experience in defining and executing Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), commissioning, and production rollout strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end project delivery, from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, testing, commissioning, production deployment, and customer handover.
* Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including solution proposals, effort estimation, technical presentations, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and customer demonstrations.
* Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles, secure system design, identity management, and network architecture is highly desirable.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and consultants, establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and technical best practices across the organization.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Middleware Operations - Kafka
description:
**Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Middleware Operations & Kafka)**
**About This Role**

* Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join the Middleware Operations team, with a primary focus on supporting and engineering enterprise Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* The role is responsible for designing, deploying, operating, securing, and optimizing large-scale messaging infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on Kafka expertise with production support, automation, observability, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

**In This Role**

* Design, deploy, upgrade, and operate enterprise-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* Configure and manage KRaft controllers, brokers, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Deploy and operate Confluent Platform on OpenShift Container Platform using the Confluent Operator.
* Provision and administer Kafka topics, ACLs, producers, consumers, partitions, retention policies, quotas, and replication settings.
* Configure Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and key rotation practices.
* Monitor and optimize platform performance, including JVM garbage collection, heap utilization, partition distribution, ISR health, disk capacity, throughput, and consumer lag.
* Troubleshoot production issues such as message loss or duplication, offset errors, broker failures, disk saturation, latency, throughput degradation, and consumer lag.
* Design and maintain platform health dashboards and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Automate provisioning, monitoring, recovery, regression testing, and operational activities using Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar technologies.
* Conduct capacity planning, performance benchmarking, and throughput optimization using tools such as KafkaPerf and kcat.
* Support incident, problem, change, and recovery management for business-critical middleware services, including root-cause analysis and preventive remediation.
* Develop infrastructure specifications, test solutions, support complex system upgrades, and contribute to application and infrastructure requirement validation.
* Establish long-term solutions for recurring production issues and identify opportunities to improve availability, resilience, and recovery time.
* Support risk and control initiatives by following technology policies, operating procedures, compliance requirements, and established work standards.
* Collaborate with application teams, engineering teams, cybersecurity partners, product managers, and infrastructure stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver platform objectives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in an on-call support rotation and provide implementation support for production releases and critical risk initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or equivalent experience demonstrated through work, education, training, or military experience.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience supporting large-scale middleware environments, including Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform.
* Strong production experience with Kafka brokers, KRaft, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kafka on OpenShift using the Confluent Operator.
* Experience managing topics, ACLs, partitions, replication, retention, quotas, idempotent producers, and consumer groups.
* Strong troubleshooting experience covering consumer lag, broker crashes, offset issues, message loss or duplication, disk saturation, latency, and throughput problems.
* Experience implementing Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, and enterprise key-management practices.
* Experience configuring Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for platform monitoring and health reporting.
* Proficiency in automation and scripting using Python, Bash, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting highly available, enterprise production environments.
* Understanding of technology risk, control, compliance, and change-management practices within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance sector.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with KRaft migrations and upgrades from ZooKeeper-based Kafka environments.
* Knowledge of performance testing and benchmarking using KafkaPerf, kafkacat, or kcat.
* Experience with Confluent Cloud, Amazon MSK, or Azure Event Hubs for Apache Kafka.
* Knowledge of schema evolution, compatibility modes, and Avro, JSON, or Protobuf serialization.
* Experience with additional messaging technologies such as Solace, IBM MQ, or RabbitMQ.
* Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, BGP, multicast, load balancing, DNS, and certificate management.
* Experience with capacity management, workload forecasting, and throughput optimization.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar monitoring and observability platforms.
* Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka or Confluent Certified Administrator certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Job Expectations
* Ability to provide production implementation and operational support outside standard business hours when required.
* Ability to participate in an on-call rotation for critical incidents and service restoration.
* Ability to work in a controlled enterprise environment with strong risk, security, audit, and documentation requirements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineering teams, business partners, management, and control functions.

* administration, monitoring tools, and excellent customer communication skills. The ability to
* remain calm under pressure, ask the right diagnostic questions, and clearly articulate

contact-center environments.

* Grafana

* Ability to analyze logs, SIP traces, packet captures, and call-flow data.

weekends, and public holidays as part of the operations support schedule.

description:

We are currently seeking a Digital Solution Cnslt. Sr. Consultant to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
The SAP Integration Suite / CPI Developer will design, develop, test, document, deploy, monitor, and support integrations between SAP S/4HANA and multiple SAP and non-SAP systems in a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role is aligned to a Greenfield+ SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE implementation using Fit-to-Standard principles, Clean Core delivery, structured governance, formal change control, and multi-wave deployment execution.
  
  
This role will work primarily with SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration, and must also support CPI-DS / SAP Cloud Integration for Data Services for SAP IBP data integration. The developer will support integrations across procurement, supplier collaboration, HR, finance, tax, manufacturing, labeling, banking, analytics, planning, and third-party enterprise applications. The position requires strong hands-on technical skills, rigorous documentation discipline, structured testing support, cutover readiness, hypercare support, and knowledge transfer to support/COE teams.
  
  
Day-to-Day Job Duties
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support integration flows using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integration scenarios.
* Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support CPI-DS jobs for SAP IBP integration, including master data and transactional data movement between SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP.
* Support SAP IBP integration scenarios involving planning areas, key figures, attributes, planning levels, master data, transactional data, full/delta loads, job scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Develop integrations involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, SuccessFactors, Concur, BlackLine, OneSource, OpenText VIM/OCR, SAP Sales Cloud, SimpleMDG, SAP IBP, SAP PLM, SAP ECTR, SAP Integrated Product Development, MES platforms, Loftware, Enlabel, SAP Document Compliance/DRC, SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SAC, Datasphere, Power BI, Snowflake, Workday, Dayforce/Ceridian, Oracle EBS, Oracle Demand Management, Oracle intercompany, Legal Tracker, Kiosk, CTSI, Reliance, tax/e-invoicing platforms, supplier/customer EDI partner systems, and other enterprise applications.
* Create interface design documents, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, routing logic, error handling designs, retry logic, reconciliation approach, monitoring procedures, runbooks, and deployment documentation.
* Support synchronous, asynchronous, file-based, API-based, message-based, EDI, B2B, cXML, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Develop integrations using adapters and protocols including IDoc, OData, REST, SOAP, cXML, ANSI X12, EDIFACT, SFTP, APIs, XML, JSON, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, and related message formats.
* Support SAP Ariba Managed Gateway / Cloud Integration Gateway scenarios for purchase orders, purchase order changes, goods receipts, service entry sheets, invoices, invoice status, payment remittance, supplier collaboration, and Business Network processes.
* Support EDI scenarios for supplier and customer-facing transactions, including direct supplier/customer EDI where standard network connectivity is not sufficient.
* Support banking and treasury integrations including payment files, bank statements, inbound/outbound messages, SWIFT/EBICS connectivity, bank onboarding, format validation, certificate/security setup, exception handling, and bank connectivity testing.
* Monitor CPI and CPI-DS jobs, troubleshoot failures, analyze logs, coordinate data corrections, manage retries and reloads, and resolve integration defects during SIT, UAT, mock cutover, production cutover, and hypercare.
* Support formal integration testing including SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, cutover rehearsals, production deployment, hypercare stabilization, and handover to support/COE teams.

SAP BTP Integration Suite Capabilities
  
  

* SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for integration flow development, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operations.
* SAP API Management for API exposure, proxy configuration, policy enforcement, and API lifecycle governance where applicable.
* Trading Partner Management and B2B capabilities where applicable for EDI and partner integration scenarios.
* SAP Event Mesh or event-driven integration concepts where applicable.
* SAP Cloud Connector, destinations, secure connectivity, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, SFTP keys, principal propagation, and network/security coordination.
* Operational monitoring, alerting, retry/reprocess procedures, interface runbooks, production support handover, and COE enablement.

Testing, Validation, Cutover, and Hypercare Responsibilities
  
  

* Support test preparation by creating integration test cases, test data needs, expected results, and interface readiness criteria.
* Support SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, and integration validation using SAP Cloud ALM or approved project tools.
* Support GxP/CSV-aware delivery where applicable, including controlled documentation, traceability, test evidence, defect resolution notes, and approval support.
* Support cutover planning, endpoint readiness, certificate/key validation, partner readiness, job scheduling, interface freeze windows, mock cutover, production cutover, and post-load reconciliation.
* Provide hypercare support including triage, root cause analysis, monitoring, reprocessing, issue closure, knowledge transfer, and support handover documentation.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with SAP IBP integration using CPI-DS in global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Experience with data load performance tuning, job scheduling, dependency management, full/delta load strategies, and high-volume planning data reconciliation.
* Experience with SAP Document Compliance/DRC and statutory e-invoicing integrations across multiple countries.
* Experience with SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SWIFT/EBICS, bank onboarding, and bank statement/payment file integration.
* Experience in GxP/CSV-regulated environments and multi-country SAP deployments.
* Experience with monitoring dashboards, alerting, operational support transition, and COE knowledge transfer.

Degree
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on SAP integration project experience may be considered.
  
  
Professional Competencies
  
  

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive assigned deliverables from design through hypercare.
* Ability to work effectively in a global delivery model across onsite, offshore, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to functional and business stakeholders.

As a senior member of the team, you will lead technical initiatives, influence engineering decisions, mentor fellow engineers, and drive operational excellence across our global network.

* Ownership – Takes ownership of the health of the environment, not just assigned tasks. Proactively identifies issues, follows through on commitments, and consistently looks for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and documentation. Believes in leaving the environment better than they found it.

* Collaborative – Shares knowledge, mentors others, communicates effectively, and recognizes that the best engineering outcomes come from strong teamwork.

“
*We hire engineers for their mindset, not just their résumé. Experience matters, but we place even greater value on ownership, technical judgment, curiosity, continuous improvement, and the ability to positively influence those around you.”*
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Own network projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Lead the technical design, optimization, and deployment of enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites.
* Develop well-supported technical proposals by analyzing operational data, business requirements, performance metrics, and long-term scalability. Present recommendations with clear trade-offs, risks, and implementation strategies.
* Provide technical leadership on cross-functional initiatives, driving engineering decisions through collaboration, sound technical judgment, and data-driven analysis.
* Review engineering designs, implementation plans, and change requests to ensure alignment with network standards and operational best practices.

* Deploy, scale, and continuously improve enterprise networking solutions across global offices and data centers.
* Support and optimize a global WAN environment consisting of Fortinet SD-WAN, Site-to-Site VPN, and point-to-point connectivity.
* Analyze application behavior, network performance, and capacity trends to recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Research, evaluate, and recommend technologies that improve network reliability, visibility, operational efficiency, and automation.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce network standards, engineering best practices, and operational procedures.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Proactively monitor network health and resolve issues before they impact production services.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts during complex infrastructure and application incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.
* Review, implement, and validate network changes in accordance with established Change Management (ITIL) processes.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver scalable, reliable network solutions.
* Act as a backup engineer on peer-owned projects to ensure continuity, knowledge sharing, and successful project delivery.

* Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills while thriving in a collaborative engineering environment.

**Technical Qualifications**
**Enterprise Networking**

* Extensive experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network (L2/L3) infrastructure using Cisco enterprise platforms (Catalyst, Nexus).
* Experience implementing and supporting enterprise security in ANY of platforms (Fortinet, Cisco Firepower/ASA, Palo Alto, or equivalent).

**Core Technical Skills**

title: GMS - Senior - Network Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Title: Specialist I, Network Engineer**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
This role provides intermediate-level network services and network problem determination support; it also delivers network services to offshore clients, manages issue resolution, and supports disaster recovery implementation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides intermediate level network services, including supporting large scale network installations and installing and configuring standard network infrastructure. Runs network configuration changes and troubleshoots and resolves issues.
* Monitors records to ensure statuses are accurate and complete, and actions are on target. Reviews related records to identify requests that may have an impact on the network.
* Provides intermediate level telecom network services for elevated issues. Identifies failing components.
* Assists in maintaining and monitoring network system performance and identifying performance issues and trends. Identifies opportunities to automate manual system tasks. Develops and maintains telecom network documentation repository.
* Assists in installing and configuring network systems. Tests configuration changes and provides basic product installation procedures.
* Complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Provides network services to offshore clients including deployment, optimization, and maintenance of network systems.
* Plans, manages, and prioritizes network issue resolution in line with business/user requirements.
* Supports implementation of a disaster recovery plan to mitigate network-related technical issues.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably in network operations or administration./ 4+ years of hands-on network ops experience in a 24x7 enterprise environment.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Network certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), CompTIA Network+, Palo Alto PCNSA, AWS Cloud Practitioner are preferred.
* Hands-on experience in configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting network infrastructure (LAN, WAN, routers, switches).
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools and automation scripts for performance tuning.
* Understanding of telecom networking components and intermediate support procedures.
* Knowledge of disaster recovery strategies and documentation practices.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Installation Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Installation Engineer to independently execute and oversee complex server and network deployments supporting enterprise physical security systems. In this mid-level role, you will take ownership of installation projects, configure advanced infrastructure components, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure seamless integration between servers, network equipment, and security endpoints. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including physical security installers and sustaining operations, while mentoring junior engineers. This position demands strong technical expertise in Dell server platforms and Cisco networking, along with the ability to provide 24x7 support in a globally distributed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead hardware provisioning activities, including advanced RAID configuration and disk array optimization, to meet performance and redundancy requirements for high-write-volume security applications such as video storage systems.
* Configure and validate Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller (iDRAC) and Lifecycle Controller settings, ensuring firmware baselines are established using Dell OpenManage before OS deployment.
* Independently deploy operating systems via PXE boot automation or iDRAC Virtual Media methods, including Windows Server and hardened Linux distributions, ensuring compliance with corporate standards.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies using VLANs and dedicated subnets to isolate physical security traffic (CCTV, PIDS, Intercom) from management networks.
* Configure Quality of Service (QoS) policies on Cisco Catalyst switches to prioritize high-bandwidth video streams, ensuring low latency and minimal packet loss for live monitoring and retention systems.
* Manage Power over Ethernet (PoE/PoE+) budgeting and monitoring on access layer switches, ensuring reliable power delivery to IP cameras, door readers, and security panels.
* Implement network device hardening best practices on Cisco IOS devices, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), disabling unnecessary services, and securing management protocols (SSH/HTTPS).
* Coordinate with network engineers and physical security installation teams to validate network readiness, port activations, and successful device-to-server communication paths.
* Execute comprehensive validation testing, including bandwidth saturation tests, physical layer distance checks, and latency measurements, before operational handoff to sustainment teams.
* Develop detailed documentation, including logical and physical topology diagrams, VLAN matrices, IP assignment records, and configuration backups.
* Provide 24x7 technical support for all in-scope infrastructure systems, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for medium-complexity issues.
* Deliver weekly project status updates and maintain programming sheet validations, as-built documentation, and asset management system accuracy throughout the deployment lifecycle.

**Required Skills**

* Related field experience with 6+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise server and network infrastructure deployment.
* Strong expertise in Dell PowerEdge server platforms, including RAID controllers (PERC), iDRAC configuration, firmware management, and Lifecycle Controller operations.
* Proficient in Cisco networking technologies, including Catalyst switches, VLAN configuration, QoS implementation, PoE management, and IOS security hardening.
* Solid experience with Windows Server and Linux operating system deployment, administration, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) and automation tools for configuration management and deployment acceleration.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams and provide mentorship to junior engineers while working in 24x7 rotational support models.

**Tools Required**

* Server & Hardware Tools: Dell iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, Open Manage, and RAID/PERC utilities for server provisioning, firmware baselining, and remote management.
* OS Deployment Tools: PXE boot infrastructure, iDRAC Virtual Media, Windows Server & Linux ISOs with hardening and automation scripts.
* Network Tools: Cisco IOS CLI, PoE management, VLAN/QoS configuration tools, network monitoring, and bandwidth/latency testing utilities.
* Automation & Operations Tools: Ansible, Python, CMDB systems, configuration backup tools, and documentation/diagramming platforms for global 24x7 operations.

title: NOC Lead
description:

title: Network Architect
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. **Network Architect**
to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. * Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.

* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.

+ GCP Networking
+ Cloud and B2B Networking
+ Palo Alto Networks firewalls
+ Meraki Wireless networking technologies
+ SD-WAN solutions

title: Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager, Infra Networking
description:
**Description**
Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones (AZs). AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones which are connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones offer AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, making them more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center infrastructures or multi-data center infrastructures. How would you like to come be part of the team that builds out that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?
  
  
Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager to help develop and scale one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. The Deployment Manager (DM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced communication construction project schedules achievable. AWS Deployment Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient connectivity solutions in the world.
  
  
As a Deployment Manager you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in fiber construction. AWS Deployment Managers are always at the forefront of the network construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers. Our networks are industry leading in terms of capacity and cost effectiveness. The DM is ultimately responsible for end to end network delivery and management of the contractors. The DM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, fiber splicing, OSP Design, ISP Construction or system installation/commissioning) and be responsible as a team member for delivering some of the most complex networks in the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As NW Infra Deployment Manager working within AWS Infrastructure you will:
  
  

* Interface with key internal stakeholders to understand the technical requirements and ensure the completed project meets these requirements.
* Project management of construction related activities and DWDM network rollout for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget;
* Ensure that the construction, fiber and optical network adheres to the defined standards;
* Perform quality audits and ensure issues are remediated;
* Understand the metro fiber market segments, customer base, and industry verticals;
* Drive scaling designs to meet the demand of our customers;
* Interface with data center providers to drive equipment and circuit installations;
* Create detailed network planning packs to build scalable and future proof infrastructure;
* Program management, risk mitigation and reporting status reviews to management and internal customers.
* Develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets;
* Understand the mechanisms used to operate and maintain one of the world’s most complex networks;
* Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time;
* Ability to work across multiple time zones;
* Willing to travel 25-50% of the time.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment & troubleshooting methodologies
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
* Knowledge of software development practices and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies
* 5+ years of technical infrastructure management experience, including network construction management and/or program management in a telecom environment
* Strong technical understanding of transport technologies (Fiber, DWDM, etc.) and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of network engineering and deployments for large-scale networks in a corporate environment, including hands-on physical infrastructure installations, hardware integration, racking, and cabling experience
* Experience communicating to a diverse, global audience
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification with experience leading multiple large network construction programs
* Familiarity with GIS platforms, quality assurance processes, and strong knowledge of long-haul transmission systems and regional construction standards
* Experience working in a fast-paced, international environment with strong contacts in fiber, transport, and infrastructure markets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer (Linux Expert)

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.
  
  
This is a technical role, providing technical support to Plume’s Enterprise customers and their various technical teams. The role covers Project/Account Management, Feature Design, implementation management of technologies and process definition. This person will be responsible for developing and maintaining expertise on the customers systems and processes as it relates to Plumes platform.
  
  
The Technical Account Manager will be required to develop and maintain an expertise in the relevant Plume products and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. In addition to knowledge on the Plume Products, the TAM will be expected to be the front line of communication with the customer as it relates to triaging issues, helping define requirements for new features, coordinating other Plume functions, representing Plumes platform capabilities such as Pods, Gateway Devices, APIs, Data, roadmaps and firmware integrations. This role will support our APAC customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work closely with Service Providers, Enterprise customers and their product technical teams to develop a good understanding of the technical issues and to coordinate the resolution within Plume. Provide both strategic and day-to-day technical expertise and support for assigned accounts.
* Act as technical liaison between Plume technical teams and other vendors of Customers such as ODM’s, chipset vendors and 3rd party software providers
* Identify Platform API product enhancement opportunities based on support trends
* Provide technical post-sales support and guidance for Platform API users
* Answer set-up related and how-to questions for Platform API users
* Drive diagnosis, troubleshooting and thorough testing of reported problems that are not easily reproducible
* Lead cross-functional customer experience review sessions with Product and Engineering to support development of innovative solutions. Communicate clear and actionable recommendations towards product improvement (including bug fixes and new features) during these sessions, and manage prioritization of these requests.
* Coordinate the definition of requirements for new features, design and ultimately development and deployment
* Help create processes and documentation for the TAM team
* Be the Subject Matter Expert for the Plume platform

**Required Skills**

* Team player, Strong verbal and written technical communication
* Working experience in managing projects involving Gateway and CPE devices
* Strong experience in triaging issues and managing communication across cross vendor technical and product teams
* Strong understanding of cloud computing architecture, technical design, and implementations including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS) delivery models
* Network management and troubleshooting skills like Serial, SSH, Telnet, Wireshark, tcpdump, NAT, Firewall, IPSec & IPtables
* Strong operating and troubleshooting knowledge across LAN/WAN technologies like switching and routing
* A demonstrated understanding of the key technology components that make up Cloud such as virtualization, networking, workloads/applications, and API’s
* Good understanding of wireless technologies like 802.11a/b/c/g/n/ac/ax
* Experience in using collaboration tools like Jira, Confluence and Slack to manage complex projects

**Qualifications**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 3 years work experience in network operations and management and SaaS services as an Architect and Support Engineering.

**About Plume**
As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.
  
  
Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume’s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
