title: Sr. Consultant - Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**What You'll Do**
**About the Team**
Principal IS API Platform Engineering & Enablement builds and operates enterprise tools that help teams develop, publish, safeguard, discover, and manage APIs in a consistent manner. The group delivers reusable platforms, automation, standards, and engineering mentorship across AWS API Gateway, Apigee, the API Management Hub, and developer enablement experiences. Our mission is to support APIs functioning as secure, reusable products by providing scalable platform capabilities, consistent governance, and an effective self-service developer experience.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a Sr. Consultant - Infrastructure Engineering at Principal, you will be a senior hands-on engineer entrusted with independently managing complex API platform capabilities from creation through production support. This role integrates software engineering, cloud platform engineering, API lifecycle management, automation, operational reliability, and technical mentoring across distributed teams. This is a remarkable opportunity to work on innovative technology and contribute to a world-class team!
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the build, engineering, development, and production support of the API platform and self-service capabilities, including the API Management Hub and developer portals.
* Develop secure, reusable AWS components using AWS CDK and TypeScript across API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, CloudWatch, and Route 53.
* Build API management functions in AWS API Gateway and Apigee, addressing proxies, products, developer applications, policies, traffic controls, and platform integrations.
* Lead the oversight of the API lifecycle including OpenAPI specifications, linting, cataloging, versioning, deployment, deprecation, reuse, and onboarding.
* Implement API security measures using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, API keys, IAM, TLS/mTLS, secrets management, and least-privilege access.
* Develop CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code automation through GitHub Actions and AWS CDK, incorporating automated testing, review, documentation, and engineering quality controls, including AI-assisted techniques when suitable.
* Ensure production stability through observability, incident and root-cause resolution, vulnerability remediation, disaster-recovery validation, and technical mentorship across engineering teams.

**Who You Are**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of hands-on software, API, cloud, platform, or integration engineering experience delivering complex technical solutions independently.
* Strong development experience in TypeScript/Node.js, with working knowledge of Python.
* Practical experience working directly with AWS CDK and API or event-driven services, such as API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and Route 53.
* Hands-on experience with AWS API Gateway or Apigee; knowledge of both platforms is preferred.
* In-depth understanding of REST, HTTP, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, error handling, rate limiting, backward compatibility, and API security through OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys, TLS/mTLS, IAM/RBAC, and secrets management.
* Experience developing CI/CD pipelines and automated quality checks using GitHub Actions, testing frameworks, code scanning, and deployment automation.
* Experience in observability and production support, encompassing logs, metrics, alerts, tracing, incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and improving system reliability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Apigee proxy, product, developer application, policy, and administration experience.
* Developer portal, API cataloging, API linting, self-service automation, or developer-experience platform engineering.
* Event-driven architecture, container platforms such as Kubernetes/EKS, and application modernization patterns.
* Terraform, CloudFormation, or other solutions for Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience operating in Agile environments with structured change, incident, problem, and knowledge-management practices.

**Additional Information**
**Our Engineering Culture**
Through our product-driven Agile/Lean DevOps environment, we’ve fostered a culture of innovation and experimentation across our development teams. As a customer-focused organization, we work closely with our end users and product owners to understand and rapidly respond to emerging business needs.
  
  
Collaboration is embedded into everything we do – from the products we develop to the quality service we provide. We’re driven by the belief that diversity of thought, background, and perspective is critical to creating the best products and experiences for our customers.
  
  
**Experience Principal**
At Principal, we value connecting on both a personal and professional level. Together, we’re imagining a more purpose-led future for financial services – and that starts with you. Our success depends on the unique experiences, backgrounds, and talents of our employees. And we support our employees the same way we support our customers: with comprehensive, competitive benefit offerings crafted to protect their physical, financial, and social well-being. Check out our careers site to learn more about our purpose, values and benefits.
  
  
**Principal is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Linux Platform / Appliance Engineer
description:
About the Role

Seeking a hands-on senior engineer to design, build, secure, release, upgrade, troubleshoot, and support the Linux platform used by the EMS enterprise appliance. EMS is deployed on physical or virtual systems in customer environments. The position requires deep Linux systems engineering combined with appliance lifecycle, containers, networking, security, virtualization, automation, and offline or air-gapped deployment experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and maintain the Linux platform for physical and virtual EMS appliances.
* Build repeatable, version-controlled, and potentially immutable Linux images.
* Own the appliance lifecycle from build and provisioning throughdeployment, validation, upgrade,rollback, recovery, diagnostics, and reimaging.
* Engineer installation and update solutions for on-premises, low-connectivity, offline, and air-gapped environments.
* Design safe OS and application update, rollback, health-validation, and recovery mechanisms.
* Engineer and troubleshoot Linux boot, systemd,networking, storage, filesystems, firewalling, logging, packages, permissions, and services.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Podman, Docker, Kubernetes/MicroK8s, or equivalent technologies.
* Use Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-managed containers where appropriate.
* Support physical hardware and virtual appliances across KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent platforms.
* Implement Linux hardening, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, package integrity, and platform security controls.
* Automate appliance image creation, testing, packaging, validation, and release.
* Build fielddiagnostics and recoverycapabilities and collaborate with software engineering, QA, cybersecurity, product, infrastructure, and support teams.

Required Experience

* 7+ yearsin Linux platformengineering, Linux systemsengineering, enterprise appliance engineering, embedded or edge Linux, infrastructure engineering, or a similar role.
* Deep hands-on Linux experience, preferably Ubuntu, RHEL, Fedora, or another enterprise Linux distribution.
* Strong knowledge of systemd, Linuxboot and OS lifecycle, networking, firewalling, storage, filesystems, package management, logging, diagnostics, security, permissions, and Bash or Python scripting.
* Experience building image-based, immutable, embedded, edge, or appliance-style Linux platforms.
* Experience creating automated OS images using Packer, custom ISO or image pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing upgrade, rollback, recovery, and reimaging solutions.
* Experience supporting on-premises, field-deployed, low-connectivity, offline, or air-gapped systems.
* Strong container experience with Podman, Docker, containerd, or equivalent OCI technologies.
* Experience with self-managed or on-premises Kubernetes environments.

* Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking, storage, containers, virtualization, and application services.
* Ability to independently design and deliver production-ready, secure, and supportable solutions.

Nice to Have

* Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-based container management.
* MicroK8s, K3s, or another lightweight Kubernetes distribution.
* Immutable Linux technologies such as Ubuntu Core, Fedora CoreOS, OSTree/rpm-ostree, read-only root filesystems, or A/B OS architectures.
* Virtual appliance experience with KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, OVA/OVF, QCOW2, VHD, or VHDX.
* Packer, Ansible, Git, infrastructure automation, and automated testing.
* CI/CD pipeline and build/release automation knowledge.
* Cloud engineering experience, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Infrastructure-as-code practicesand cloud servicessupporting artifact management, security scanning, testing,monitoring, or releases.
* Linux security hardening, CIS Benchmarks, PKI, certificates, trust stores, signed updates, and artifact validation.
* Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, journald, or equivalent observability technologies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a Linux engineer who builds platforms and products, not simply someone who administers Linux servers. The strongest candidates will have experience with Linux-based appliances, industrial or edge systems, networking or security appliances, embedded platforms, or other long-lived on-premises products where reliability, security, controlled updates, offline operation, and field serviceability are critical.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About This Role**
The Microsoft 365 Engineer is the hands-on technical owner for the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of the KGS Microsoft 365 tenant, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, Bookings, and Microsoft 365 Apps. This individual contributor role reports to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace and supports employees across the global KGS tenant from India.
  
  
The role is equally accountable for adoption across the organization, making sure employees at every site and in every function know how to use Microsoft 365 well. Success is measured through usage data, training reach, and reduced support demand. The engineer works within the standards set by the governance and cyber security teams, turning policy into services that are well run and well used.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Microsoft 365 Platform Administration**

* Administer and configure Exchange Online, including mail flow, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and transport rules.
* Administer SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business, including site provisioning, permissions, storage, and sharing settings.
* Administer Microsoft Teams, including meeting, calling, and messaging policies, app management, and Teams Rooms where applicable.
* Configure and support Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings, and manage tenant settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
* Manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment and update channels in partnership with the endpoint team.
* Automate administration tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph, and maintain configuration documentation and as-built standards.

**Identity, Licensing & Access**

* Manage license assignment through group-based licensing, along with Microsoft 365 groups and membership, within approved access policies.
* Partner with the identity team on Entra ID, conditional access, and MFA as they affect Microsoft 365 services, escalating exceptions to the policy owner.
* Track license consumption and report right-sizing opportunities to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace.

**Governance, Security & Compliance (Execution)**

* Apply the Teams and SharePoint standards set by the governance and cyber security teams to provisioning, naming, lifecycle and expiration, external sharing, and guest access.
* Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention policies, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies as directed by the cyber security and compliance teams.
* Action eDiscovery and legal hold requests as directed by the legal team.
* Review Microsoft Secure Score and recommendations relevant to Microsoft 365 workloads, and remediate findings with approval.

**Adoption & Change Management (Organization-wide)**

* Build and execute the Microsoft 365 adoption plan across all KGS sites and functions, and establish and run a Microsoft 365 Champions program.
* Create training content, including quick-reference guides, short videos, live and virtual sessions, and onboarding content for new hires.
* Run targeted campaigns that move teams from file shares and email attachments to collaboration in OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams, and that introduce tools such as Loop and Planner.
* Use Microsoft 365 usage analytics, Adoption Score, and Viva Insights where available to measure adoption, identify low-usage groups, and target them.
* Maintain an internal Microsoft 365 help and learning hub on SharePoint.
* Communicate Message Center roadmap changes to the business in plain language ahead of rollout.

**Migration & Projects**

* Execute file share and legacy platform migrations into SharePoint Online and OneDrive using the SharePoint Migration Tool, Migration Manager, or third-party tools.
* Support tenant consolidation, merger and acquisition, and divestiture work as required.
* Pilot and roll out new Microsoft 365 features in a controlled, well-communicated way.

**Support, Monitoring & Service Management**

* Serve as the second and third-level escalation point for Microsoft 365 incidents raised by the service desk and IT Field Engineers.
* Monitor Service Health and Message Center, assess the impact of incidents and changes, and manage Microsoft support cases through to resolution.
* Use ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices in the ITSM tool.
* Create knowledge base articles that enable the service desk to resolve Microsoft 365 issues at first contact.
* Will be the on-call for critical Microsoft 365 incidents.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on administration experience with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration, with working knowledge of Entra ID and license management.
* Experience delivering end-user training or adoption activities.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices and hands-on experience with an ITSM tool.
* Able to work onsite at the assigned KGS site in India, with the ability to travel up to 10%.
* Flexible schedule to accommodate overlap with the Americas and Europe and occasional on-call needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, or Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer.
* Experience delivering SharePoint Online migrations at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, retention, data loss prevention, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and the wider Power Platform.
* Prosci or other change management certification, with experience running Microsoft 365 champion programs.
* Readiness and rollout experience with Copilot for Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Intune and Microsoft 365 Apps deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing or multi-site global organizations.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong communicator, able to explain technology clearly to non-technical users.
* Trainer and presenter mindset, comfortable leading sessions for audiences of any size.
* Strong customer service orientation, displaying professional standards.
* Analytical and data-driven, using usage data to guide adoption decisions.
* Keen attention to detail in configuration and change control.
* Automation-first mindset, scripting repeatable tasks rather than repeating them by hand.
* Manages conflicting priorities and stays calm under pressure during incidents.
* Able to work autonomously and follow direction as provided.
* Collaborates effectively with peers and stakeholders across time zones.
* Continuously learns and keeps pace as the Microsoft 365 roadmap evolves.
* Challenges the status quo and drives improvement.
* Strong organizational and task management skills in a fast-paced environment.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Location**
: On-site (Hyderabad)

**Type**
: Full-Time

**Reports To**
: Founder

**About PHNX Securities**

https://www.phnxsecurities.com/

PHNX Securities is a next-generation quantitative trading firm, focused on systematic, research-driven strategies. Our approach combines deep market understanding with robust engineering — emphasizing clean execution infrastructure, rigorous backtesting, strict risk controls, and full regulatory readiness.

**Our Mission**

To combine advanced research, automation, and disciplined risk management to create scalable, repeatable, high-conviction quantitative strategies across global markets.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to design, build, and maintain the low-latency network infrastructure connecting our trading systems to exchange colocation environments (including NSE colocation).

This role operates at the intersection of exchange connectivity, network architecture, and production infrastructure reliability, with a strong emphasis on low-latency design, multicast market data delivery, and hands-on ownership of our colocation rack. You will work closely with our trading infrastructure team to ensure our systems have fast, reliable, and resilient connectivity to the exchange.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and maintain network connectivity between our colocation rack and NSE trading systems
* Configure and manage BGP (unicast routing) and PIM-SM (multicast routing) for order entry and market data connectivity
* Troubleshoot and resolve network-related latency and performance issues across production trading infrastructure
* Own physical layer setup and compliance — fiber handoffs, patch cords, switch/transceiver configuration, and NSE audit readiness
* Manage out-of-band hardware management (IPMI/BMC) for remote server administration in the colo environment
* Coordinate with NSE colocation support and remote-hands teams for troubleshooting, circuit migrations, and hardware issues
* Collaborate with the trading/quant dev team on network-level latency optimization (NIC tuning, kernel bypass considerations, etc.)
* Maintain documentation of network topology, configurations, and connectivity architecture for internal reference

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience in network engineering, ideally in a trading, fintech, or low-latency environment
* Strong knowledge of routing protocols — BGP (eBGP), and multicast routing (PIM-SM, IGMP)
* Solid understanding of L2/L3 network design and client-server network architectures
* Hands-on experience with Cisco IOS/NX-OS or equivalent network operating systems
* Experience with datacenter/colocation network setups — fiber connectivity, patch panels, SFP/SFP+ transceivers
* Familiarity with IPMI/BMC and out-of-band server management
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix systems administration
* Understanding of exchange connectivity concepts (market data feeds, order entry, redundancy design) — NSE experience strongly preferred

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Direct experience with NSE colocation infrastructure or Indian exchange connectivity
* Experience with multicast market data distribution in a trading environment
* Exposure to time synchronization (NTP/PTP)
* CCNA or higher certification
* Familiarity with low-latency network tuning (kernel bypass, NIC offloading) — DPDK/Solarflare exposure a plus

**Candidate Profile**

* Strong systems thinker with attention to detail and reliability
* Able to work closely with trading/dev teams and leadership in a small, high-ownership environment
* Calm and methodical under pressure — network issues during market hours require fast, precise troubleshooting
* Willing to be hands-on with physical infrastructure (rack visits, cabling, hardware troubleshooting) when needed

**Why Join PHNX Securities**

* Build and own critical trading infrastructure from the ground up
* Work directly with the Founder and core trading infrastructure team
* Exposure to real exchange colocation environments and low-latency systems
* Opportunity to shape the firm's network and infrastructure foundation

title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1–2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:**

* Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools.
* Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing.
* Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
* Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
* Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:**

* Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
* Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions.
* Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts.

* Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures.
* Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures.

Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
  
  
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
  
  
Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
  
  
Mid-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
  
  
Afternoons bring cross-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end-to-end live monitoring experience -- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

description:
**About The Company**

**Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer**
Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Experience: Minimum 5-7 years
  
  
**Qualification**
B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience
  
  
OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Certifications Required**
OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:
  
  
Cisco SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage.
  
  
CEH certified
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.
  
  
The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  
  
Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  
  
Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.
  
  
Analyze SD-WAN alarms, events, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve network incidents.
  
  
Configure and troubleshoot application-aware routing, traffic steering, SLA-based path selection, QoS, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Perform configuration and policy changes through centralized SD-WAN management and orchestration platforms.
  
  
Implement SD-WAN policies, templates, profiles, routing configurations, security policies, and application-based traffic steering as per approved requirements.
  
  
Support deployment and implementation of new SD-WAN sites, branches, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
  
  
Participate in SD-WAN migration projects, including migration from traditional MPLS-based networks to SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform SD-WAN edge device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and validation activities.
  
  
Support integration of SD-WAN with existing network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Internet gateways, and cloud platforms.
  
  
Perform health checks, configuration backups, software upgrades, firmware upgrades, and patch management for SD-WAN infrastructure.
  
  
Troubleshoot performance issues related to latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth utilization, and application performance.
  
  
Coordinate with ISPs and telecom service providers for resolution of WAN link-related incidents and performance issues.
  
  
Work with L1 and L3 teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SD-WAN incidents and service-impacting issues.
  
  
Participate in the incident, problem, and change management processes and ensure compliance with defined ITIL processes and SLAs.
  
  
Validate and implement approved SD-WAN change requests, including impact assessment, implementation planning, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  
  
Support SD-WAN high-availability configurations, redundancy testing, failover testing, and DR drills.
  
  
Perform planned and emergency changes during maintenance windows and ensure proper post-change validation.
  
  
Support troubleshooting and implementation of SD-WAN security features, including IPsec encryption, segmentation, secure connectivity, and integration with next-generation firewalls.
  
  
Support network segmentation using VPN/VRF and SD-WAN segmentation policies based on business and security requirements.
  
  
Perform configuration-level remediation activities identified through vulnerability assessments, security audits, and compliance reviews.
  
  
Analyze and act upon OEM advisories, security vulnerabilities, bug notifications, and recommended software upgrades relevant to SD-WAN platforms.
  
  
Maintain updated network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation documents, SOPs, MOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
  
  
Create and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring SD-WAN incidents, known errors, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
  
  
Prepare operational reports covering SD-WAN availability, incidents, link performance, SLA compliance, capacity utilization, and recurring issues.
  
  
Generate reports and dashboards related to SD-WAN health, network performance, incidents, and service trends.
  
  
Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for operational reporting, data analysis, and management presentations.
  
  
Coordinate with OEM support teams for complex technical issues and track cases through resolution.
  
  
Participate in technology refresh, capacity expansion, and SD-WAN optimization initiatives.
  
  
Continuously optimize SD-WAN configurations and policies to improve network availability, application performance, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Ensure compliance with defined security policies, operational procedures, change management processes, and SLA requirements.
  
  
Maintain awareness of the latest SD-WAN features, technologies, best practices, and product enhancements from Cisco, Fortinet, Versa, and other relevant OEMs.
  
  
**Technical Skills / Desired Competencies**
Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking and SD-WAN operations.
  
  
Good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, control plane, data plane, management plane, and orchestration components.
  
  
**Hands-on Experience With One Or More Of**
Cisco SD-WAN / Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN / FortiGate
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, NAT, DNS, DHCP, ACL, IPsec, GRE, and routing concepts.
  
  
Good hands-on knowledge of BGP, OSPF, static routing, route redistribution, and routing policies.
  
  
Good understanding of MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G and hybrid WAN connectivity.
  
  
Experience in troubleshooting IPsec tunnels, overlay/underlay connectivity, routing issues, packet loss, latency, jitter, and application performance.
  
  
Knowledge of QoS, application-aware routing, traffic engineering, and dynamic path selection.
  
  
Understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, segmentation, secure tunnels, encryption, and security policies.
  
  
Experience with SD-WAN monitoring, centralized management, orchestration, and analytics platforms.
  
  
Ability to perform packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark, ping, traceroute, and vendor-specific troubleshooting utilities.
  
  
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to handle critical network incidents under SLA-driven operations.
  
  
Ability to work in a multi-vendor environment and adapt to different OEM technologies and operational processes.
  
  
Strong communication and coordination skills for working with L1/L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and client stakeholders.
  
  
Willingness to work in 24 7 operations / rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required by business needs.
  
  
Strong documentation and reporting skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent network diagramming tools.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience in large enterprise or managed services environments.
  
  
Experience supporting geographically distributed branch networks.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN implementation, migration, and rollout projects.
  
  
Experience in multi-vendor SD-WAN environments involving Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa.
  
  
Experience in managing critical incidents and participating in major incident management processes.
  
  
Experience in network automation, API-based configuration, or SD-WAN orchestration is an added advantage.
  
  
Experience working with ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management processes.

title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)
description:
**Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role**
**Overview**
We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices.
* Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability.
* Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks.
* Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, and iw sub-systems.
* Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms.
* SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs.
* Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication.
* Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding.
* Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369).
* Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management).
* Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries.
* Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems.
* Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems.
* Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369).
* Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM.
* Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers.
* Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts.
* Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind.
* Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**

* Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7.
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution.
* Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e.g., CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context.
* IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP.
* Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs.

40
  
  
**Time Type**
Regular
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India, Hyderabad, India

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development and experience in technical support
* 5+ years of operations management experience
* 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* Experience in facilities management, or experience in project management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
* Knowledge of six Sigma/Lean processes
* Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
* 2+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: NOC Tier 2 Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
Role Summary
  
  
The Tier-2 NOC Engineer takes escalations from Tier-1 and restores service across our customer contracts, which span on-premises, Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, each with its own SLA. You will troubleshoot across network, compute, operating system, database, application and cloud layers, engage vendors and internal teams, and keep customers informed during major incidents.
  
  
You will also make the NOC better over time: tuning noisy alerts, writing and automating runbooks, and raising problem records so recurring issues are fixed for good. You will work closely with the SOC, providing infrastructure data during security investigations.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Key Responsibilities**
Diagnose and Restore
  
  

* Take escalated tickets from Tier-1 and troubleshoot across network, compute, OS, database, application and cloud layers.
* Restore service through fixes, failover, scaling, or rolling back a bad change, within contract SLAs.
* Identify the likely root cause and record it, with resolution notes, in the ticket.

Change Management
  
  

* Raise and implement emergency changes needed to restore service.
* Roll back changes that cause incidents, and check whether a recent change caused an incident.
* Execute critical out-of-band patches when requested by the SOC and validate service health after patching.

Coordination and Communication
  
  

* Engage vendors (Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, ISPs and others) and internal infrastructure and application teams.
* Send status updates to customers and stakeholders on each contract's schedule during P1/P2 incidents.
* Collect and provide data (logs, configurations, flow data) to the SOC on request during security investigations.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring or unexplained issues.
* Tune alerts: remove noisy ones, adjust thresholds, and action false-positive tuning requests from Tier-1.
* Write and improve runbooks and automate common fixes so Tier-1 can resolve more issues at first contact.
* Coach Tier-1 analysts on troubleshooting and runbook use.

**Scope and Escalation Boundaries**
Inputs this role works from
  
  

* Escalated tickets from Tier-1 with triage evidence
* Monitoring data across all tools, CMDB/service maps per contract, change records and vendor contacts
* Requests from SOC Tier-2 for infrastructure data

Escalate to NOC Tier-3 / engineering when
  
  

* The root cause is outside standard operations (code defect, architecture limit, product/IoT firmware, capacity design).
* A fix needs a significant change or design decision.
* The issue is not resolved within the P1/P2 time limit (e.g., 1 hour of active work on a P1).

Escalate to the Incident Commander (war room) when
  
  

* There is a major incident: several contracts affected, a full customer outage, a likely SLA breach with penalties, or a possible security cause.

**Required Skills**
Technical Depth
  
  

* Hands-on depth in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of the rest:
* Network: TCP/IP, OSI model, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancers, network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Systems: Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux administration.
* Databases: Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server (performance, blocking, storage, job failures).
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure and AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring).
* Applications: Java-based applications, web and application servers, application logs.
* Working knowledge of the products and IoT devices for the contracts supported.
* Log analysis across firewalls, routers, switches, servers and applications.

Monitoring and Observability Tools
  
  

* SolarWinds: NPM, NetFlow analysis, node and interface health.
* AppDynamics: transaction tracing and application performance analysis.
* Oracle Enterprise Manager: database and middleware performance analysis.
* Site24x7: synthetic monitoring and availability checks.
* Azure Monitor and AWS CloudWatch: metrics, alarms and log queries.
* PRTG Network Monitor and Nagios
* Ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira or similar) and Microsoft 365.

**Scripting standards this role follows:**

* All scripts kept in Git in an approved, peer-reviewed library.
* Read-only by default: diagnostic scripts never change anything; scripts that make changes need a change or ticket reference.
* No hard-coded credentials: credentials are pulled from a vault.
* Parameterized by contract and CI, safe to run twice, and logging what they did into the ticket.

Process Skills
  
  

* ITIL incident, problem and change management, including emergency changes and rollbacks.
* Vendor escalation and management.
* Shift handover and incident documentation.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Structured, analytical troubleshooting under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal technical updates for both technical and customer audiences.
* Attention to detail, and the ability to manage several incidents at once.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python for automation that spans several systems (e.g., one script that checks a service across Azure, AWS and on-premises).
* Splunk SPL basics.
* Network device CLI for reading switch, router and firewall state.
* Experience in a multi-customer or managed services NOC with contract-specific SLAs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* CCNA or CompTIA Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
* CompTIA Security+

title: Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer
description:
**About SkySpecs:**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding turbine blade health. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

Join a collaborative team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Leads, and Developers dedicated to building and managing a state-of-the-art analytics and decision-support platform tailored for the renewable energy sector. Together, we deploy, operate, and maintain the essential software and infrastructure that seamlessly connects diverse customer data systems with Horizon CMS, our advanced drivetrain analytics platform.

**As a Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer, you will:**

* Configure, deploy, and maintain tools and infrastructure that enable the flow of CMS,
* SCADA, and other data into our cloud-based platforms, including Horizon CMS
* Detect, track, and resolve data connectivity issues across the entire fleet of customer data system integrations
* Help maintain underlying AWS infrastructure for data connectivity
* Collaborate with service delivery teams to ensure high-quality, reliable data is available for their analysis and reporting
* Respond to data connectivity trouble tickets and work the issues to completion
* Work with the connectivity team to create and improve processes needed for increased scalability and efficiency

**Requirements of the job:**

* 3+ years of work experience in a technical engineering, operations, or analyst role
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Strong Unix/Linux command line skills
* A basic understanding of data protocols, networking concepts, and IT security practices
* Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
* Ability to work outside normal business hours, when needed, to support the global team

**Bonus Point:**

* Experience in the wind power industry, especially drivetrain condition monitoring
* Proficiency with AWS tools and services like S3, EC2, VPC, and CloudWatch
* Experience with data analysis tools and scripting, e.g., using Python, SQL
* Capability and willingness to use AI tools, such as advanced LLMs, to increase productivity
* Degree in Engineering, or an applicable technical degree from an accredited university

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Network Development Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
As an Network Development Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you are an experienced Builder. You will own the design and delivery of automation systems that transform capacity restoration from a manual, labor-intensive process into a scalable, self-service operation. You will architect solutions, lead technical projects end-to-end, mentor NDEs, and partner with service teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader tooling ecosystem. This role demands strong software engineering skills, deep networking knowledge, and the ability to drive results across organizational boundaries.
  
  
Technical strategy is defined; component design is not. You are trusted with autonomy and are expected to make pragmatic trade-off decisions at product and component levels, identify and eliminate patterns affecting reliability and availability, and define and simplify team processes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Automation & System Design
  
  

* Own design and delivery of automation systems that restore out-of-service capacity with minimal manual intervention.
* Develop end-to-end link automation frameworks that transform manual troubleshooting into automated, system-guided restoration workflows.
* Build and improve centralized device health validation services for border, backbone, and regional network layers.
* Design self-service frameworks and next-step engines for automated troubleshooting and remediation.
* Architect solutions that are scalable, secure, maintainable, and extensible across a growing multi-timezone team.

Metrics & Monitoring
  
  

* Create and maintain the metrics and monitoring infrastructure for CRT: capacity out-of-service dashboards, burndown tracking, TTR, restoration success rate, and SLA compliance.
* Build systems to track and optimize bandwidth utilization trends, available capacity vs. projected peak, and redundancy coverage.
* Design automation to improve in-team resolution percentage and reduce escalation to Operations and Engineering teams.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Lead technical projects end-to-end; drive engineering best practices for development, testing, deployment, and operational excellence.
* Mentor NDEs; actively participate in hiring and conducting technical assessments.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader ecosystem.
* Identify and proactively address architectural or process deficiencies affecting restoration performance, reliability, and scalability.

Operations
  
  

* Participate in on-call rotations and operational reviews for follow-the-sun coverage.
* Lead complex incident response for capacity events; drive root-cause analysis and remediation for systemic failures.

A day in the life
  
  

* Review the capacity out-of-service dashboard; triage restoration priorities by customer impact and network health blocking status.
* Design and implement scalable automation to systematically restore capacity at fleet level (e.g., end-to-end link lifecycle automation).
* Solve complex network problems applying correct technologies and best practices; lead design reviews and architecture discussions for restoration tooling.
* Identify patterns affecting reliability/availability and drive them out through automation improvements.
* Partner with service teams to integrate self-service automation capabilities into the broader tooling ecosystem.
* Mentor engineers on software engineering best practices and system design.
* Participate in hiring, interview processes, and technical assessments for the team.
* Contribute to long-term technical strategy and automation roadmap; hand off active restoration work to your counterpart in the next time zone.

**About The Team**
The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end-to-end restoration of out-of-service inter-metro and intra-metro network capacity.
  
  
CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time-to-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
  
  
We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow-the-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
  
  
**About Aws**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* - 5+ years of experience in network development engineering, software engineering for networking, or network automation.
* - Proficiency in Python or another scripting/programming language for building network automation tools and services.
* - Experience with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS) in large-scale network environments.
* - Experience designing and implementing automation for network operations at scale.
* - Experience with workflow orchestration systems and service-oriented architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of network hardware and packet forwarding architectures
* Experience working in a large-scale networking environment
* Experience building end-to-end network automation (link lifecycle management, device provisioning, health validation).
* Experience with network design and selecting platforms for implementation at hyperscale.
* Experience with workflow orchestration engines and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with distributed systems concepts applied to networking at scale.
* Experience building automation for large-scale networks with no scheduled downtime.
* Familiarity with deployment automation tools, link testing services, and operational event monitoring systems.
* Experience with data analysis and mining for operational insights.
* CCNP, JNCIP, or equivalent networking certification.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40
