title: System Administrator
description:
Winsupply is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Systems & Security Administrator (L2) with 2 to 4 years of experience to support our hybrid enterprise infrastructure and frontline security operations. In this role, you will safeguard core digital assets across multi-regional environments—monitoring endpoint and web application security events, deploying critical system patches, and responding to operational incidents. Alongside security monitoring, you will play a key role in maintaining system uptime, verifying data backups, and supporting database and network health. This is an excellent opportunity for a technical professional looking to expand their expertise across both enterprise systems administration and frontline SecOps within a collaborative global team.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our technical operations, ensuring high availability across servers, networks, and databases while executing critical backup routines and disaster recovery procedures. In addition, you will act as the frontline responder for security alerts (EDR/XDR and SIEM), vulnerability patching, and off-hours operational disruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Database Maintenance & Monitoring**

* Monitor relational database health, CPU utilization, disk space, memory utilization, connection pool limits, and blocking locks (e.g., DB2, SQL Server, MariaDB, or MongoDB).
* Track replication status, high-availability cluster health, and alert on replication lag or database service interruptions.
* Perform operational maintenance tasks including checking table bloat, space allocation, and executing standard service restart playbooks during scheduled off-hours.

**2.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Storage Management**

* Oversee and verify automated daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules across enterprise systems, databases, and cloud/on-premise storage.
* Actively investigate backup failures, resolve storage capacity bottlenecks, and re-trigger failed backup jobs.
* Participate in scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and execute routine restoration validations to ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly maintained.

**3.Network & Operating System Administration**

* Administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) environments, including user access, OS patching, disk space management, and system services.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including DNS resolution failures, DHCP scopes, routing issues, and VPN tunnel drops.
* Verify firewall traffic rules, monitor reverse proxy/load balancer health checks, and manage SSL/TLS certificate renewals to prevent service outages.

**4.Endpoint & Web Application Security Monitoring**

* Monitor enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Defender for Endpoint).
* Triage high-severity alerts, including
  **WildFire Malware**
  sandbox verifications,
  **Local Analysis Malware**
  , and suspicious process executions.
* Execute frontline containment procedures, including host network isolation and account lockdowns following established security playbooks.
* Monitor Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and API gateways for abnormal traffic spikes, suspicious request patterns, and Layer 7 anomalies.

**5.Vulnerability & System Patch Management**

* Track infrastructure and endpoint vulnerabilities across Linux, Windows, and third-party software.
* Plan, test, and deploy monthly OS patches, kernel updates, and critical security hotfixes during approved off-hours maintenance windows.
* Coordinate patch rollbacks and mitigation steps if updates conflict with production databases or application dependencies.

**6.Incident Response & SIEM Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary responder for off-hours system outages, database alerts, network interruptions, and high-priority security incidents.
* Monitor enterprise SIEM queues (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) for suspicious authentication attempts, brute-force patterns, and privilege escalation.
* Facilitate swift triage, coordinate with upstream engineering/DBA leads when needed, and lead post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reporting.

**7.Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and shift handover records.
* Track and report on key operational SLAs, including backup success rates, patch compliance percentages, and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

**Candidate Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Support, or an integrated SysAdmin / SecOps role.
* **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **OS & Networking:**
  Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP troubleshooting, and basic firewall configurations.
* **Database & Backups:**
  Hands-on experience checking database services and locks, combined with practical exposure to enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, AWS Backup, native DB dumps).
* **Security Tools:**
  Practical familiarity with EDR/XDR consoles (Palo Alto Cortex XDR preferred) and SIEM alert monitoring.
* **Scripting (Advantageous):**
  Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or Python to automate basic health checks and log reviews.
* **Work Style:**
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset under incident conditions.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to work in rotational shifts and participate in scheduled off-hours/weekend on-call rotations.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Associate or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or (ISC)² SSCP are preferred.
* Familiarity with web application security concepts and common vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Basic scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and log processing are a plus.
* Experience operating within a SIEM or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is advantageous.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services.
* Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.

**Desirable:**

* 5+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling
* RCA findings and write-ups; runbook and knowledge-base upkeep
* ITIL incident, problem and change processes
* Willingness to work 24×7 rotational shifts from office

Good to have
  
  

* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional); HashiCorp Terraform Associate; ITIL v4 Foundation
* Exposure to Elastic Security (SIEM) and detection rules
* Azure log sources and networking (Event Hub, Azure Monitor)
* Linux administration and shell scripting

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Clear written and spoken communication for tickets, RCAs and stakeholder updates

title: SAP PI - CI Engineer [T500-30335]
description:
**About Costco Wholesale:**

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.

**Position Summary:**

The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of SAP Process Integration and SAP particularly Cloud Integration (CPI) and API Management along with a strong understanding of modern enterprise architecture and integration best practices. The SAP PI/CI Engineer is responsible for the design, build, testing, implementation, and environment support of SAP BTP Integration solutions and associated application components. In this role, you will design and develop interfaces using SAP as the middleware tool, delivering SAP integration solutions for hybrid scenarios using integration protocols and adapters (SFTP, SOAP, REST, etc.). You will also support application engineers, functional business specialists, and client team members to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.

* Lead efforts to design, develop, test, troubleshooting and maintenance of integration components for applications and systems. SAP APIs, web services, and middleware platforms.

* Identify and resolve integration issues, system errors, and performance bottlenecks.
* Monitor and maintain integration landscapes, ensuring smooth data flow and providing support for system integrations and process orchestration.

* Works independently and within a team environment.
* Pays attention to detail, self motivated with the ability to follow instructions and completes assignments on time.
* Learns and applies new concepts, processes, and tools.

* Understand, refine and comply with integration patterns, standards, guidelines, and best practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and standards.
* Ability to lead small teams of contractors and mentor junior Engineers.
* Build and maintain a solid understanding of the application areas and the business areas they support.
* Takes initiative to solve problems and multi-tasks by prioritizing projects and deadlines.
* Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders, and all levels of management.
* Work with PI/CI team members and prepare system documentation, training material, and configuration and process documentation.
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.

**Experience, skills, education & licenses/certifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Business, or another related technical discipline.
* Experience with Integration suite and CPI.
* 10+ years of experience developing interfaces using SAP , PI/CI, ABAP, and APIs.
* Skilled in interface design and development using SAP as the middleware tool.
* Experience linking SAP to both SAP and multiple non-SAP systems.
* Experience coordinating full lifecycle SAP implementations from preparation through go live and operations.
* Experience with protocols and formats such as flat file, SFTP, SOAP, REST, RFC, IDoc, etc.
* Knowledge of SAP IDoc processing and monitoring services.
* Knowledge of REST architecture/technology and experience with REST/OData adapters.
* Working knowledge of SAP finance-related business processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport and supports understanding among both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to analyze problems and provide clear recommendation
* Hands on experience working with business users and Solution Architects to determine integration requirements, develop and test PI/CI interfaces.
* Experience with Groovy and JAVA Scripting.
* Experience in the configuration of adapters such as JMS, SFTP, SOAP, IDOC, Proxy, FTPS, web services, and iFlows.
* Experience working in and administering a multi-tenant PI/CI Environment.
* Experience with CTS+ transport management and alert configuration.
* Experience in integration with SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors with On-premise solutions.
* Experience in setting up Keystore, generating SSL certificates and SSH Tokens.
* Must be self-motivated, responsible, conscientious, and detail-oriented.
* Must have proven ability to set and follow priorities and timeline.
* Ability to develop repeatable development processes with supporting documentation.
* Must have the ability to build lasting trusted partnerships across various functional areas and technical disciplines. Able to support off-hours work as required, including weekends, holidays, and 24/7 on call responsibilities on a rotational basis
* International travel may be required

**Recommended:**

* Experience with SAP PI/CI 7.4 or higher.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Connector.
* Experience with BPM design and modeling. optional
* Experience integrating custom and package products across complex enterprise environments.
* Working understanding of security standards such as SAML, XACML, MASSL, and OATH.
* Successful internal candidates will have spent one year or more on their current team

**Other Conditions:**

* Management will review the Job Analysis for this CIsition prior to a job offer

title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
  
  
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology & Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications**
. The role combines hands-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
  
  
**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**

* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Clinical Workflow & Application Support**

* Support end-to-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order-to-result processes, medication-management workflows, imaging order-to-report processes and associated ancillary-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.

**3. Integrations, Interfaces & Data Exchange**

* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.

**4. Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management**

* Own or coordinate high-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.

**5. Change, Release & Environment Management**

* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production-readiness checks across on-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change-management controls.

**6. Monitoring, Reliability & Continual Improvement**

* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self-service, standardisation and knowledge-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.

**7. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, known-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster-recovery exercises or major clinical go-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical & Domain**
**Operational Leadership**
**Ways of Working**

* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation
* Clear executive communication
* Knowledge sharing and collaboration

**Success Measures**

* Service availability, SLA achievement and timely restoration of clinically significant incidents.
* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.
* Quality and completion of root cause, corrective action, change validation and operational-readiness activities.
* Improved monitoring coverage, documentation quality, automation adoption and cross-training readiness.
* Stakeholder confidence in service ownership, communication and operational follow-through.

**Note:**
The 8-12 year experience range is recommended to reflect the expanded lead-level scope and should be aligned with the organisation's approved job architecture before publication. Product-specific requirements may be added based on the final application portfolio.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)
  
  
Location: UST Hyderabad
  
  
Type: Full time, in-house
  
  
**About The Role**
Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write
  
  
audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green
  
  
deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.
  
  
We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You
  
  
will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Architecture and roadmap
  
  

* Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.
* Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.
* Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.
  
  

* Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security
  
  

* Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).
  
  

* Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.
* Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate
  
  

* Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.
* Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.
* Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.
* Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.
  
  
Work with others
  
  

* Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.
  
  

* Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.
* Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.
  
  

* You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.
* You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical
  
  

* AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.
* Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.
* Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.
* Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.
* Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.
* Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working
  
  

* You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.
* You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.
* You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.
* Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.
* FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.
* Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like
  
  

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.
* Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.
* A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.
* The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.
* Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

**Skills**
AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

**About us**

At Gameopedia, our journey began in Norway with a simple mission: to be the geeky gamer friend who helps people discover great games and have better gaming experiences. From humble beginnings, we quickly made our mark, landing our first major customer just a year later, one of Norway’s largest news publications. That milestone led us to expand to India, where five passionate gamers began building Gameopedia around a dining table in a small apartment.

Today, with offices in Oslo and Hyderabad, we provide industry-leading video game data, metadata and insights to some of the world’s biggest companies, powering experiences and decisions for millions of gamers every day.

Over more than 15 years, we have built deep gaming expertise and one of the industry’s richest and most structured sources of video game data. Our ambition is to make Gameopedia the

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities

We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of high quality Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers in India

* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve

* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of ADSIPL’s Data Centers in India and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

A day in the life
  
  
Managing and developing teams of high quality Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
We're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, resilience, and day-to-day health of HealthEdge's infrastructure across AWS and our hybrid on-prem/Azure/GCP estate. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering and infrastructure engineering spanning AWS migration execution, disaster recovery, patching and platform currency, and the security/compliance controls that keep our security obligations intact. It's a hands-on senior IC role for someone who wants deep ownership of infrastructure resilience across a large, multi-account, multi-platform environment that's actively migrating off legacy on-prem infrastructure.
  
  
**Areas of Responsibility:**
**Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud Architecture**

* Own infrastructure across the environments including secure configuration baselines and patch management for OS images and on-prem hardware
* Design, build, and maintain infrastructure across AWS (primary), with supporting work in Azure and GCP, plus the on-prem estate still in active retirement
* Build and maintain reusable, auditable Infrastructure as Code for cloud deployments, and for remaining on-prem server deployment.
* Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work.
* Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts.
* Support AWS migration execution for in-flight waves, including server deployments and resource change requests via IaC.

**Disaster Recovery & Resilience**

* Own disaster recovery architecture and execution across cloud environments.
* Maintain DR solutions and backup strategy and run DR drills on a regular cadence; document gaps and drive remediation.
* Design for resilience from the start and treat recoverability as a first-class requirement, not an afterthought.

**Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management**

* Contribute to vulnerability management triage across infrastructure teams, threat detection, and infra security findings review.
* Support PHI/PII classification scanning, penetration test coordination, and security exception approvals.
* Maintain compliance controls; support HIPAA and SOC 2 audit readiness, access review and recertification, evidence collection, and change freeze coordination.
* Maintain EKS container runtime security sensor coverage as part of ongoing platform hardening.

**Cloud Infrastructure Operations**

* Design and manage roles and cross-account access controls following least-privilege principles across multi-account, multi-cloud environments.
* Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards.
* Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability.
* Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience.
* Own infrastructure health, cost, and performance monitoring using native and third-party tooling, building the observability that lets issues surface before they become incidents.
* Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services.
* Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate.

**CI/CD, Automation & Delivery**

* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines for secure, repeatable infrastructure deployments.
* Write automation to reduce manual toil and enforce operational consistency across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Take solutions from proof-of-concept to production with an eye toward long-term maintainability, not just getting it working once.

**Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor, scale, and maintain production infrastructure with availability, performance, and security as top priorities.
* Participate in on-call rotation; serve as L2 escalation point for cross-team infrastructure support; lead root cause analysis and drive incident retrospectives to closure.
* Author and maintain runbooks that hold up under pressure, not just at handoff.

**Cost & Tagging Governance**

* Contribute to FinOps efforts: identify and remediate cost anomalies, own tagging remediation against enterprise tagging standards, and make pragmatic cost/performance/resilience tradeoffs.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting.
* Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure.
* Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments.
* Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
* Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management.
* Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale.
* Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement.
* Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) and understanding of what that means for infrastructure and DR design specifically.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect or SysOps, Associate or Professional).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure, bridging on-prem virtualization with cloud-native services during active migration.
* Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows.
* FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement.
* Healthcare technology or digital health platform background.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows as part of daily practice.

**Behaviors & Traits**

* Raises risk early rather than waiting for it to become an incident.
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a large, multi-account, evolving cloud environment.
* Strong sense of ownership; closes gaps rather than escalating and waiting.
* Communicates technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The
**GNOC Engineer**
is responsible for monitoring the organization's global network and infrastructure environment, identifying and responding to alerts and incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, and coordinating escalations with network, infrastructure, security, and other technical teams. The role requires strong operational discipline, communication, and the ability to work effectively in a
**24x5 shift**
environment with the potential to support a future 24x7 model.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Monitor network, infrastructure, connectivity, and service health using enterprise monitoring and management tools.

• Identify, validate, prioritize, and respond to alerts and incidents in accordance with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

• Perform
**Level 1/Level 2**
troubleshooting for
**network connectivity, WAN/LAN, VPN, wireless, firewall**
, and infrastructure-related issues.

• Create, update, and maintain incident and service tickets with accurate troubleshooting details and timelines.

• Escalate incidents to Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, vendors, or other resolver groups when required.

• Follow established SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and change-management processes.

• Perform proactive monitoring and identify recurring alerts, trends, and potential service-impacting issues.

• Support incident bridges and major incident activities, including timely communication and escalation.

• Coordinate with global teams and vendors during outages, maintenance windows, and service-impacting events.

• Maintain shift handover documentation and ensure clear communication of open incidents, risks, and follow-up actions.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including alert tuning, automation, documentation, and operational process improvements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

•
**2+ years**
of experience in
**NOC, GNOC, network operations, infrastructure operations**
, or a similar technical operations role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals:
**TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPN, and WAN connectivity.**

• Experience with network/infrastructure monitoring tools and ticketing platforms.

• Ability to troubleshoot incidents methodically using logs, monitoring data, connectivity tests, and documented procedures.

• Good understanding of incident, problem, and change management concepts.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for incident escalation and shift handovers.

• Ability to work independently in a shift-based, 24x5 operational environment.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple alerts and incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Experience with tools such as
**SolarWinds, PRTG, LogicMonitor, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow**
, or equivalent platforms.

• Exposure to
**Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, Aruba, Meraki,**
or similar networking technologies.

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent operational knowledge.

• Networking certification such as CCNA or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Exposure to cloud networking, SD-WAN, SASE, or automation is a plus. What Success Looks Like

• Consistent monitoring and timely response to alerts and incidents.

• Meeting operational SLAs and escalation timelines.

• Accurate ticket documentation and effective shift handovers.

• Reduction of recurring alerts through proactive investigation and improvement.

• Strong collaboration with global resolver teams.

• Contributing to automation, standardisation, and readiness for future 24x7 operations.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a technically strong and dependable operations professional who can remain calm during outages, think through real-world scenarios, communicate clearly, and take ownership from initial alert through resolution or escalation. The ideal candidate should demonstrate practical troubleshooting ability rather than relying only on theoretical knowledge.

title: Tech Lead – Cloud Content Delivery (CDN Migration)
description:
Job Description: Tech Lead – Cloud Content Delivery (CDN Migration)
  
  
**Level:**
L4 / Tech Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad (or as applicable)
  
  
**Function:**
Cloud Advisory / Managed Services – Content Delivery & Edge Infrastructure
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a
**Tech Lead – Systems Engineering**
to own and drive the migration of content delivery workloads from Akamai to Amazon CloudFront. Beyond hands-on architecture and delivery, this role carries technical leadership of the migration workstream — setting technical direction, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and acting as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders through planning, execution, and cutover.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Technical Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end migration of content delivery workloads from Akamai to Amazon CloudFront — origin configurations, cache behaviors, and edge locations
* Architect and deploy CloudFront distributions with appropriate cache policies, origin request policies, and response header configurations
* Design and implement AWS WAF rules, web ACLs, and managed rule groups to secure migrated workloads
* Own the design and quality of Terraform modules for CloudFront, WAF, and supporting AWS resources, establishing reusable patterns for the team
* Drive cache validation, latency testing, and traffic cutover verification across all migration phases
* Define and enforce standards for runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational handover documentation

**Technical Leadership**

* Set the technical approach and migration strategy in collaboration with architecture and delivery leadership
* Review peer designs, Terraform code, and cutover plans; ensure adherence to security, performance, and IaC best practices
* Mentor and upskill junior and mid-level engineers on CDN architecture, WAF configuration, and IaC practices
* Act as primary technical escalation point during cutover windows, coordinating with cross-functional teams (network, security, application owners)
* Communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs to internal stakeholders and, where required, client stakeholders

**Requirements**
**Experience**

* 5–12 years of professional experience as a Systems Engineer, with demonstrated technical leadership on at least one significant infrastructure migration or modernization initiative

**Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Amazon CloudFront — distribution configuration, cache behaviors, and origin setup
* Proficiency in AWS WAF — web ACLs, managed rules, and custom rule authoring
* Working familiarity with Akamai CDN, sufficient for accurate migration mapping (origin, caching, and security control equivalence)
* Strong Terraform skills for Infrastructure as Code across AWS resources; able to define reusable, production-grade modules
* Proficient in Java and Python for scripting, automation, and tooling
* Comfortable owning technical decisions independently and defending them in design reviews

**Leadership & Communication**

* Prior experience guiding or mentoring engineers, or informally leading technical workstreams
* Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both engineering and business stakeholders

Good to Have
  
  

* AWS Certification (Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, or Advanced Networking Specialty)
* Experience with observability tooling for CDN performance (CloudWatch, Real User Monitoring)
* Exposure to client-facing delivery in a consulting/systems integrator environment

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates automated, secure, and scalable cloud platforms across AWS and Azure for enterprise clients. This is a hands-on engineering role — owning landing zone architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and observability — with the technical depth to troubleshoot production issues and the maturity to mentor junior engineers and influence platform standards across client engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform & Landing Zone Engineering
* Design and build secure, multi-account/multi-subscription landing zones on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations) and Azure (Landing Zones, Management Groups).
* Implement network architecture — VPCs/VNets, transit gateways, hybrid connectivity, DNS, and security group / NSG design.
* Define and enforce account/subscription governance guardrails, tagging standards, and cost controls.
* Infrastructure as Code & Automation
* Author and maintain infrastructure using Terraform (primary) and/or CloudFormation / ARM / Bicep, structured as reusable modules.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for both infrastructure and application deployments.
* Drive GitOps practices for environment provisioning and change management.
* Containers & Orchestration
* Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS) including networking (CNI), ingress, autoscaling, and RBAC.
* Support containerization of legacy and modernized workloads in partnership with application and modernization teams.
* Implement service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity patterns where applicable.
* Observability & Reliability
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent.
* Define and track SLIs/SLOs for platform services; participate in on-call rotation and incident response.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for production issues and drive permanent fixes, not just workarounds.
* Security & Compliance
* Implement identity and access management (IAM roles/policies, Azure AD/Entra ID RBAC), least-privilege access, and secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
* Embed security controls into pipelines (SAST/DAST, image scanning, policy-as-code with tools such as OPA/Sentinel).
* Support compliance requirements relevant to client engagements, including DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and client-specific regulatory frameworks under Minfy's Kavach360 programme.
* Cost & Operational Efficiency
* Monitor and optimize cloud spend using native cost tools (Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management) and rightsizing recommendations.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual operational toil across managed environments.
* Client & Cross-Functional Engagement
* Work directly with client engineering and infrastructure teams as a trusted technical resource on managed services and migration engagements.
* Partner with the MiMo and Cloud Advisory teams to implement platforms that support migration and modernization roadmaps.
* Produce clear runbooks, architecture diagrams, and platform documentation.
* Mentorship & Technical Contribution
* Mentor junior and mid-level platform engineers; review their IaC and pipeline contributions.
* Contribute reusable modules, scripts, and accelerators to Minfy's internal platform engineering toolkit.
* Participate in architecture reviews and champion platform engineering best practices across the BU.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience
* 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience operating production workloads on both AWS and Azure (multi-cloud experience required).
* Core Technical Skills
* Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code.
* Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or AKS) — deployment, troubleshooting, and day-2 operations.
* Strong CI/CD skills — designing and building end-to-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, rolling).
* Strong containerisation skills — Docker image build and optimization, multi-stage builds, container registries (ECR, ACR), and container security scanning.
* Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VPC/VNet design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity.
* Security & Governance
* Working knowledge of IAM/RBAC design, secrets management, and policy-as-code.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise cloud environments (Well-Architected Framework, ISO 27001, DPDP Act 2023 or equivalent).
* Collaboration & Communication
* Comfortable working directly with client technical stakeholders and cross-functional Minfy teams (advisory, MiMo, security).
* Able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate incident/root-cause findings effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, or CKA/CKAD.
* Experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux).
* Exposure to service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
* Prior experience in a partner/SI or managed services environment (AWS Premier/Advanced Partner or Microsoft Solutions Partner).
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ownership — treats production platforms as their own; drives issues to permanent resolution.
* Automation-first mindset — defaults to codifying repeatable work rather than manual intervention.
* Technical depth with pragmatism — balances best practice with delivery timelines and client constraints.
* Collaboration — works effectively across client teams, internal BUs, and junior engineers.
* Continuous learning — stays current across a fast-moving, multi-cloud technology landscape.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

* Provide feedback to the product development teams on customer needs and pain points.
