title: Analyst - IAM SSO Engineer
description:
**Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer will be a mid-level technical resource responsible for implementing, integrating, and supporting authentication solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. This role requires strong hands-on experience with SSO, MFA, application integrations, infrastructure components, cloud platforms, and scripting to support secure and reliable authentication services.
  
  
The ideal candidate is hands-on, technically strong, and able to troubleshoot complex authentication, integration, and infrastructure issues with limited guidance.
  
  
This role is based out of Hyderabad, India and requires coming into the office.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implement and support authentication solutions across SSO, MFA, and identity federation use cases.
* Ensure seamless user authentication experiences across applications and platforms.
* Configure and integrate applications with IAM platforms such as Okta, Auth0, PingFederate, or similar access management tools.
* Support authentication capabilities such as user registration, self-service, authentication, authorization, administration, audit, and reporting.
* Integrate applications using modern protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and header-based authentication.
* Support IAM platform improvements that align with security, infrastructure, and business requirements.
* Identify opportunities for improving the SSO/Okta environment and implement enhancements.
* Work with application, infrastructure, cloud, security, and development teams to gather requirements and implement effective authentication solutions.
* Configure access policies, sign-on policies, MFA rules, and risk-based authentication controls based on business and security requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain authentication standards.
* Conduct regular system audits to ensure performance and compliance with security standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance standards and experience with audit support activities.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, API, application, and infrastructure teams to document authentication patterns, integration standards, and troubleshooting steps.
* Stay current with emerging security threats, technologies, and industry trends to continuously improve the security posture.
* Assesses current applications and architecture to ensure current implementations align with industry guidelines, best practices and management approved standards.
* Develop and maintain scripts or automation to simplify IAM operations, reporting, monitoring, and integration support activities.
* Provide advanced production support to diagnose and resolve authentication, SSO, MFA, integration, agent, network, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in incident response and security incident investigations related to IAM systems.
* Develop and deliver applicable documentation, training, and knowledge transfer to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Evaluate and hands on implement automation capabilities to simplify processes and deliver value/cost savings to the business.
* Foster the Agile DevOps culture through the latest toolset to improve customer satisfaction through rapid, continuous delivery.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 6+ years of overall IT experience
* 4+ years of hands-on experience supporting authentication, SSO, MFA, or access management solutions
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Okta, Auth0, PingFederate, Azure AD/Entra ID, or comparable access management tools
* 3+ years of scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Working knowledge of infrastructure, networking, cloud, and DevOps concepts used to support authentication platforms
* Okta Certified Administrator or equivalent IAM certification preferred
* BS/BA degree or equivalent experience
* Security, cloud, or CIAM certifications are a plus
* Experience with CIC/Auth0 platform is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Proven track record in implementing IAM solutions in a large, complex environment.
* Strong understanding of federated authentication, SSO, and SAML along with the ability to make recommendations, scope, and execute on opportunities for automation or improvement in identity system architecture.
* Hands-on experience implementing authentication services in enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting IAM or CIAM implementation activities, including requirements review, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Proven track record of understanding B2B and B2C customer needs and delivering solutions that enhance user experience while maintaining security and compliance standards.
* Thorough understanding of security best practices, privacy regulations (such as GDPR, CCPA), and compliance requirements related to customer data protection.
* Broader IAM domain experience with focus on information security
* Deep technical expertise in solutioning and integrating B2B, B2C applications with CIAM.
* Strong working knowledge of IAM platforms such as Okta, PingFederate, Auth0, Azure AD/Entra ID, or similar tools used to enable SSO for cloud and on-premises applications.
* Hands-on experience building SSO integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, header-based authentication, and federation patterns.
* Experience in designing Consumer identity and access management solutions
* Strong understanding of the latest security principles like zero trust and passwordless authentication to implement new standards in the authentication model.
* Must have working knowledge of Okta Lifecycle Management and Administrative APIs
* Experience with solutions like CyberArk, Beyond Trust, RSA or comparable products.
* Excellent understanding of REST integration concepts
* Experience in directory services like Oracle LDAP, and AD
* Experience supporting authentication services in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or hybrid infrastructure.
* Hands-on scripting or development experience using JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, Java, Node.js, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
* Hands on experience with JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PowerShell, or other scripting languages preferred.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation in Azure or AWS.
* Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar infrastructure-as-code tools is preferred.
* Experience in Monitoring tools like Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, or similar tools
* Experience with container technologies Docker, Kubernetes
* Experience with Linux and Windows platforms, middleware, web servers, load balancers, agents, certificates, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience developing workflows, custom connectors, and troubleshooting complex issues.
* Experience with Agile and DevOps tools and methodologies
* Minimum Okta Certified Administrator: Okta Certified Consultant and/or Okta Certified Developer preferred.
* CISSP / CIAM Certification is a plus.
* Experience in Auth0 and SiteMinder is preferred.

Non-Technical skills:
  
  

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
* Deliver outcomes with a little supervision, must be a self-starter and self-motivator.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex and competing priorities.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality results.
* Ability to think strategically and suggest creative solutions.
* Ability to synthesize complex requirements into simple business practices.
* Flexible and able to adapt to changing priorities.

title: Observability Engineer - Lead Managed Services Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
LeadManaged Services Engineer II
  
  
The Enterprise Observability Platform Tech Architect is responsible for architecting end-to-end observability solutions across hybrid cloud environments, driving strategy and implementation for large-scale enterprise monitoring. This role will focus on leveraging technologies such as ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), OpenSearch, AppDynamics, and integrating with modern DevOps practices using infrastructure-as-code (IAC) tools like Terraform on leading cloud platforms (AWS).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Design, architect, and implement enterprise observability platforms using ELK, OpenSearch, and AppDynamics to deliver monitoring, logging, and tracing capabilities across hybrid cloud environments.
* Define and enforce observability standards, frameworks, and practices; integrate solutions with DevOps pipelines; and enable automation across development, quality assurance, and production environments.
* Lead migrations from legacy monitoring tools and automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform across multi-cloud environments.
* Collaborate with Cloud, Security, and Application Development teams to deliver secure, scalable, cost-effective solutions and optimize storage, search, and visualization performance for log and metric data.
* Develop technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and solution blueprints; provide technical leadership and mentoring; evaluate emerging technologies; and participate in on-call or production-support activities as required.

**The team**
At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad / Bengaluru**
**Shift Timings: Rotational Shifts**
**Qualifications**
**Required**
:
  
  

* Experience architecting and implementing enterprise observability platforms using ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) or OpenSearch.
* Experience configuring application performance monitoring, logs, metrics, and distributed tracing using tools such as AppDynamics, New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Jaeger, and troubleshooting distributed systems, application performance, and data-ingestion issues.
* Experience applying site reliability engineering (SRE), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), and information technology service management practices, including service level indicators, service level objectives, service level agreements, error budgets, incident, problem, and change management, capacity planning, disaster recovery, resilience engineering, and ServiceNow.
* Experience using GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform to automate infrastructure and platform deployments.
* Experience designing, deploying, or operating workloads on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience developing automation or scripts in Python, Shell, or Groovy.
* Experience implementing identity and access management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS), and compliance monitoring for cloud platforms.

**Preferred**
:
  
  

* AppDynamics Certified Implementation Professional certification.
* Elastic Certified Engineer, Elastic Observability Engineer, or OpenSearch Practitioner certification.
* Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect certification.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification.
* DevOps or site reliability engineering certification.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Cloud Operations Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?**

  

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

  

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

  

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

  

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

**About the role**

  

We're Matillion - and we're building the first AI Data Automation platform. Our cloud infrastructure isn't a back-office function; it's the engine that powers everything our customers rely on. As a Cloud Operations Analyst, you'll be a key architect of that engine, owning the reliability, scalability and security of our cloud-native platforms across AWS, GCP and Azure. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of Cloud Infrastructure, FinOps and SRE, and you'll be working in a small, focused engineering team where your decisions have real, visible consequence.
  
  
This isn't a reactive ops role. You'll be proactively identifying bottlenecks, driving automated remediation, applying AI tooling to accelerate workflows and partnering with Finance to make sure we scale efficiently. If you thrive with autonomy, think in systems and believe cloud infrastructure should be engineered with clinical precision, this is for you.

**What you will be doing**

  
* Designing, implementing and continuously improving Matillion's cloud infrastructure estate and Infrastructure as Code across AWS (primary), GCP and Azure, and conducting deep-dive performance analysis and driving automated remediation of bottlenecks
  
* Leading FinOps initiatives; analysing cloud spend, managing Reserved Instances and Savings Plans, and partnering with Finance to ensure we scale efficiently and responsibly
  
* Applying AI-powered developer tools (including Claude Code) to research, automate and accelerate operational workloads without compromising on safety or quality
  
* Managing Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker deployments at scale, scripting automation in Python, Go or Bash, and owning the consistency and reliability of our cloud-native platforms
  
* Mentoring junior analysts, leading technical knowledge shares, and driving continuous improvement in the team's ways of working by building a culture of documentation and operational excellence
  
  

**What we are looking for**

  
* Demonstrable experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps or SRE role supporting high-availability SaaS environments with advanced, hands-on AWS expertise (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS) and proven Terraform mastery including complex state files and code modularisation
  
* A sharp eye for cost optimisation; you can analyse cloud usage data, identify inefficiencies and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations that guide real infrastructure decisions and keep spend aligned to growth
  
* Strong Kubernetes (EKS) and containerisation experience at scale, paired with solid scripting ability in Python, Go or Bash for automating operational tasks
  
* A genuine willingness to master AI-powered developer tooling; you see AI as a force multiplier for productivity, not a threat to quality
  
* Autonomy and a bias for action; you dig into problems independently, think in systems, supervise AI outputs with rigour, and don't wait to be told what needs fixing

  

**More about Matillion**

  
  

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:

  

  
* Company Equity
  
* 27 days paid time off
  
* 12 days of Company Holiday
  
* 5 days paid volunteering leave
  
* Group Mediclaim (GMC)
  
* Enhanced Parental leave policies
  
* MacBook Pro
  
  

  
  

**Your Safety**

  
  

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to 
matillion.com/careers
to verify open roles or reach us at
talent@matillion.com
.

  
  
  

**Want to know more?**

  
  

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at 
talent@matillion.com.

  

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.

  
  
  

*Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Tech S And T - Senior Consultant - Resilience - ISR - Senior - GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Consultant - Infrastructure Resilience**
**Experience Range: 5-8 Years**
**Role Summary**
Support infrastructure resilience, disaster recovery, and recovery readiness initiatives across compute, storage, backup, virtualization, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role focuses on resilience assessments, DR testing, recovery validation, ransomware recovery preparedness, and improvement planning.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct resilience assessments across compute, storage, backup, virtualization, cloud, identity, and network services.
* Evaluate recovery strategies, dependency mappings, recovery sequencing, and recovery readiness.
* Execute DR tests, failover/failback exercises, recovery simulations, and validation activities.
* Assess backup and storage environments for recovery readiness, replication, immutability, retention, and RPO/RTO alignment.
* Develop and maintain DR plans, recovery runbooks, and recovery procedures.
* Support ransomware recovery preparedness, trusted restore validation, and recovery exercises.
* Identify resilience gaps, recovery risks, and SPOFs, and provide remediation recommendations.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, operations, application, audit, and business teams.
* Prepare assessment reports, recovery roadmaps, and client deliverables.
* Support workshops, solutioning, and consulting engagements.

**Required Skills**

* 5-8 years of experience in infrastructure resilience, disaster recovery, or related infrastructure domains.
* Strong understanding of compute, virtualization, storage, backup, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Experience with backup technologies, replication, snapshots, immutable backups, retention, and restore processes.
* Knowledge of networking concepts including LAN, WAN, redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
* Experience with DR planning, recovery testing, failover/failback, dependency mapping, and recovery validation.
* Understanding of ransomware recovery, trusted restores, and recovery preparedness.
* Strong documentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
* Understanding of hosting models, cloud platforms, and datacenter strategies.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to AI/GenAI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry-driven resilience solutions.
* Knowledge of Python, PowerShell, or automation scripting.
* Basic understanding of database backup, recovery, and resilience concepts.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Azure, AWS, VMware VCP, or similar infrastructure certifications preferred.
* Experience supporting infrastructure transformation, resilience, or DR programs.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Ability to independently manage assessment and testing activities.
* Comfortable working across infrastructure, cloud, operations, risk, audit, and business teams.

* Zscaler Management: Handle the deployment, configuration, policy administration, and troubleshooting of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).

* Network Security Operations: Support traditional network security controls including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
* Operations & Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex network security issues, utilizing packet capture tools (Wireshark) to diagnose connectivity and performance anomalies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the infrastructure and network teams to ensure smooth integration of Zscaler with SD-WAN and cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

**Required Skills & QualificationsZscaler Expertise (Mandatory)**

* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZIA (Cloud Firewall, Sandbox, Native SSL decryption).
* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZPA (App Connectors, Access Policies, User Portals).
* Proven experience troubleshooting Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) issues on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

**Core Network Security & Networking**

* Production experience with at least one major firewall platform (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).
* Solid understanding of core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN).
* Good grasp of standard authentication protocols (SAML, Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) as they integrate with Zscaler.

**Logistical Requirements**

* Must be available to join immediately or within a 30-day notice period.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP).
* Certification in firewall technologies (e.g., PCNSE, NSE 4).
* CCNA/CCNP Security.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work flexibility balancing collaborative in-office days with focused remote work.
* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

title: System Development Engineer I
description:
**Description**
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce & Sustainability team (WWRR&S) at Amazon.com.
  
  
WW RR&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWRR&S is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and sustainability.
  
  
Amazon WW RR&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. description:
**Description**
Senior Engineer – Amazon Connect/ Telephony- Hyderabad (Hybrid)
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Mission:**
Our Technology Operations team enables the Commercial organization to deliver scalable, automated, and reliable customer engagement platforms. We focus on building systems that reduce manual effort, accelerate delivery, and enable consistent, high-quality customer experiences.
  
  
**The Role:**
Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will serve as a builder and technical owner for our Amazon Connect telephony platform. Your primary focus will be designing and developing scalable IVR systems, automation frameworks, and integrations that power our contact center.
  
  
This role is build-first, with success measured by your ability to create reusable, automated, and scalable solutions that reduce operational overhead and accelerate feature delivery. While you will support complex troubleshooting when needed, your core responsibility is to eliminate recurring issues through better design and automation.
  
  
You will establish engineering patterns across IVR, backend services, and integrations, enabling Engineer II resources to efficiently deliver within a well-structured and automated platform.
  
  
This role will work a hybrid schedule in our Hyderabad office, meaning candidates need to be able to attend the office 2- 3 days a week. This is a second shift role (2 pm- 11 pm IST).
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Design and build scalable IVR systems and call routing logic in Amazon Connect.
* Develop backend services using Lambda, APIs, and data storage solutions such as DynamoDB.
* Create automation frameworks for telephony workflows, including dynamic routing, system-triggered actions, and configuration management.
* Build reusable components and patterns to standardize development across the platform.
* Design and implement integrations between Amazon Connect and Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Build and enhance custom Contact Control Panel (CCP) solutions to support agent workflows.
* Enable seamless, automated data exchange across telephony and enterprise systems.
* Design systems that prevent issues rather than react to them, including strong error handling, fallback logic, and resiliency patterns.
* Implement automated monitoring, alerting, and where possible, self-healing mechanisms.
* Continuously identify and eliminate manual processes through automation.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or recurring issues that require deep technical analysis, with a focus on root cause elimination rather than repeated fixes.
* Mentor Engineer II resources by providing clear designs, reusable patterns, and development standards.
* Break down complex systems into executable work for the broader team.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, and Platform Operations to deliver scalable solutions.
* Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on cloud-based systems.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Connect, including IVR development.
* Strong experience building backend systems using AWS services such as Lambda, APIs, DynamoDB, and S3.
* Experience designing automation frameworks and event-driven architectures.
* Experience integrating Amazon Connect with Salesforce Service/Health Cloud or similar platforms.
* Strong understandingof telephony concepts including IVR, SIP, PSTN, and VoIP.
* Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable systems from the ground up.

**Preferred:**

* Experience building custom Contact Control Panel (CCP) solutions.
* Experience with Amazon Kinesis or similar tools for real-time data and automation.
* AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect, Developer, or Connect Specialty.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong builder mindset with a focus on scalable and reusable solutions.
* Proactive in identifying inefficiencies and eliminating them through automation.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with an emphasis on prevention over reaction.
* Clear communicator who can translate complex systems into actionable plans.
* Collaborative and focused on enabling team-wide efficiency and quality.

**Key Success Measures:**

* Reduction in manual telephony operations and interventions.
* Increased automation coverage across IVR and workflows.
* Faster delivery of new telephony features and enhancements.
* Reduction in recurring production issues due to improved system design.
* Improved developer velocity through reusable components and patterns.

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will serve as a builder and technical owner for our Amazon Connect telephony platform. Your primary focus will be designing and developing scalable IVR systems, automation frameworks, and integrations that power our contact center.

**Position Summary**

As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and securing cloud and network infrastructure, Kubernetes or container platforms, and production AI or model-serving workloads.
* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.

description:

title: CloudOps Engineer IV
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a CloudOps Engineer IV to join the SRE organization supporting Paylo, PDI’s payments, loyalty, and fuel-pricing product suite. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role focused on keeping high-traffic, customer- and partner-facing platforms reliable, secure, and running efficiently across multi-cloud infrastructure.

  
  

 You will bring strong, hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform/OpenTofu, Jenkins, and Datadog, and apply it directly — building and operating infrastructure, improving deployment pipelines, and strengthening observability. You will work under the direction of the Senior Manager, SRE, executing against the team’s reliability and infrastructure roadmap while bringing your own judgment and technical leadership to the problems in front of you.

Cloud Infrastructure & Operations: 
  
 
  

  
* Build, operate, and troubleshoot infrastructure across AWS and Azure in support of production workloads.
  
* Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including deploying and maintaining Helm charts for the services you support.
  
* Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and drive them to resolution within your area of ownership
  
* Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and resilience improvements for the systems you support

* Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment pipelines using Argo CD/Argo Workflows, including rollout and promotion configuration across environments.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, improving build/deploy automation and reliability.
  
* Support progressive delivery practices (blue-green/canary, automated rollback) for the services you support
  
  

  
 
  
Reliability & Observability:
  
 
  

  
* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards, monitors, and alerts for the services you support, tuning alert thresholds to reduce noise.
  
* Contribute to defining SLIs/SLOs for your services and help track them over time.
  
* Participate in postmortems for incidents you're involved in, and follow through on assigned remediation items
  
  

  
Collaboration & Mentorship:
  
 
  

  
* Partner with engineers across the SRE team and with product engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and improve system design.
  
* Share knowledge with and mentor less-experienced engineers on the team (CloudOps Engineer I III) on cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
  
* Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for the systems you support.
  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

  
* 10+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles

* Hands-on experience with Argo CD/Argo Workflows for GitOps-based continuous delivery.
  
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, OpenTofu).
  
* Hands-on experience with Jenkins and Rancher for CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance.
  
* Hands-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform), including building dashboards, monitors, and alerts.
  
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
  
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
* Experience supporting payments, fuel/retail, or loyalty platforms, or other systems with PCI DSS or similar compliance obligations
  
* Relevant certifications such as CKA/CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

* Define standards for actionable alerting, thresholds, routing, deduplication, and noise reduction.

* Validate hypotheses using evidence‑based diagnostics rather than trial‑and‑error recovery.
* Serve as a go‑to expert for complex, ambiguous failure scenarios and cascading incidents.

**Root Cause & Resilience Engineering**

* Influence reliability outcomes across teams without direct authority.

**Goals & Outcomes**

* Deliver measurable, sustained improvements in MTTD and MTTR for priority platforms.
* Reduce repeat incidents and operational toil through systemic fixes.
* Improve signal‑to‑noise ratio across enterprise monitoring.
* Enable responders to diagnose complex failures rapidly and confidently.
* Increase overall production resilience and advisor/client experience.

**Required Expertise & Experience**

* 10-14+ years of progressive experience in Production Services, SRE, ICC/NOC, or large‑scale operations engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in enterprise incident management and ITSM practices.
* Advanced, hands‑on experience with Dynatrace (dashboards, alerts, service flows, diagnostics).

+ AWS (EC2, ALB/NLB, RDS, IAM, networking, failure modes)

Advisor and investor experience

WW RR&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWRR&S is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and sustainability.
  
  
Amazon WW RR&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
Support engineers troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer-identified alarms, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate routine operational tasks. If you have a strong Application Support background, are interested in growth and have passion to develop tools at large scale, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW RR&S, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce & Sustainability team!

You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks and operational tooling.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 4+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and securing cloud and network infrastructure, Kubernetes or container platforms, and production AI or model-serving workloads.
* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.
* Familiarity with the broader machine learning lifecycle and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow.
* Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or SageMaker AI; Microsoft Foundry or Azure Machine Learning; Google Vertex AI; vLLM; KServe; NVIDIA Triton or NIM; Ray Serve; or comparable platforms.
* Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes or multi-tenant inference environments.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKA, CKS, or cloud and Terraform certifications

Senior Manager – Certificates & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

Kolkata & Hyderabad

About the Role

Inceptial Tech is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) engineering and certificate lifecycle management within the Information Security function.

The role involves managing enterprise PKI platforms, cryptographic key protection, certificate automation, and security operations while leading engineering teams and ensuring reliable, secure production services.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead PKI engineering teams and oversee technical delivery.

\* Manage enterprise Certificate Authority (CA) hierarchies, HSMs, and key management processes.

\* Oversee certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and lifecycle automation.

\* Manage code-signing, device certificates, and user certificate services.

\* Define cryptographic standards, certificate policies, and approved algorithms.

\* Coordinate with vendors and Certificate Authority providers.

\* Ensure platform availability, audit readiness, and certificate expiry prevention.

\* Support cryptographic agility and post-quantum cryptography migration planning.

Required Skills

\* Strong expertise in PKI architecture and certificate lifecycle management.

\* Knowledge of X.509 certificates, TLS, certificate validation, revocation, and trust stores.

\* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).

\* Familiarity with platforms such as Venafi, Keyfactor, DigiCert, Entrust, or HashiCorp Vault.

\* Experience with ACME, certificate automation, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).

\* Strong knowledge of cryptographic key management and code signing.

\* Experience in technical leadership, vendor management, and security operations.

Experience & Qualifications

\* 15–18 years of experience in infrastructure or security engineering.

\* At least 3 years of team management or technical leadership experience.

\* Experience managing enterprise-scale PKI platforms and production certificate services.

\* CISSP, CISM, or relevant PKI certifications are preferred.

About Inceptial Tech

Inceptial Tech is a global technology solutions company operating across the UK, USA, Germany, and India, delivering IT consulting, software development, Testing-as-a-Service, and managed Oracle Cloud services.

title: Network Engineer – Deployment and Support
description:
**About The Job**
As 'Network Engineer – Deployment and Support' within our Digital Technology Service Quality team, you will deploy, and support the enterprise network that connects Sanofi — LAN and WAN, WLAN, data center fabric, SD-WAN, and cloud networking across AWS and Azure. You will deploy infrastructure as code using Terraform, Ansible, and Python wherever the platform allows, and apply the same engineering rigor where it does not. You will own what you deploy — from design validation and automated pre-change checks through to day-two operations, capacity management, and incident response — ensuring our network estate remains accurate, performant, resilient, and ready for AI-enabled operations. Ready to get started?
  
  
**Our Team**
Digital Technology – Service Quality is at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. We deliver secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure services that power business-critical applications and enable thousands of users across the enterprise. Our network engineering team owns the connectivity that every other service depends on — spanning offices, laboratories, manufacturing sites, data centers, and multiple cloud providers. Our team combines modern cloud platforms, automation-first engineering, and service excellence to support Sanofi's mission of chasing the miracles of science.
  
  
**About Sanofi**
We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
**Network Deployment – Infrastructure as Code and Automation**

* Deploy cloud network infrastructure as code using Terraform, provisioning virtual networks and VPCs, subnets, route tables, peering, transit gateway and virtual WAN hubs, VPN gateways, and ExpressRoute and Direct Connect attachments across AWS and Azure, with reusable modules, remote state management, and plan review built into the change process
* Deploy and maintain network configuration as code using Ansible, building reusable roles and templates for Cisco IOS and NX-OS, FortiOS, and Junos devices so that every deployment is repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable
* Automate network provisioning and operational tasks in Python, consuming platform APIs — Cisco APIC for ACI fabric, Junos Space for Juniper estate management, Prisma SD-WAN and FatPipe controllers, and F5, Array, and AVI load balancer APIs
* Automate vendor web consoles and portals that expose no usable API using Selenium, so that carrier portals, licensing, and legacy management interfaces do not force manual work
* Use NEXUS as an AI agent within the engineering workflow to accelerate configuration generation and peer review, triage large log and packet-capture data sets, draft runbooks and knowledge articles, and scaffold Ansible and Python automation
* Maintain Git as the source of truth for network configuration, with golden configuration templates, peer-reviewed changes, and a full version-controlled audit trail
* Operate deployment pipelines for network change, including automated pre-change validation, standards compliance checks, and automated post-deployment verification of routing state, reachability, and interface health
* Implement configuration drift detection and automated remediation, so deployed network configuration provably matches its declared intent
* Codify network standards — naming, addressing, VLAN and VRF conventions, hardening baselines, and device software targets — and gate deployments against them
* Drive deployments from an authoritative source of truth for IP addressing and inventory, rather than from spreadsheets
* Implement zero-touch and templated onboarding so new switches, access points, and site routers reach a compliant baseline without manual console configuration

**Network Deployment – Engineering Delivery**

* Deploy network configuration items (CIs) including Cisco IOS and NX-OS switches and routers, Juniper devices, Aruba wireless controllers and access points, load balancers, and network appliances, from initial requirement through to validated production handover
* Deliver network deployments at offices, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and on-premises data centres, including physical installation, rack and stack, structured cabling, optics, power and environmental checks, and high-availability pairing
* Deliver hardware refresh, end-of-life replacement, and firmware and network OS upgrade campaigns across Cisco IOS/NX-OS, FortiOS, and Junos platforms, including RMA handling across the device estate
* Execute controlled environment promotion (Dev to Pre-Prod to Production) with documented rollback and recovery plans for every deployment
* Register all deployed CIs in the CMDB with correct class, attributes, relationships, ownership, location, and lifecycle status at point of deployment
* Configure and maintain network discovery and SNMP so network CIs are correctly classified with accurate serial numbers, models, and discovery-source behavior
* Onboard every newly deployed CI into monitoring, telemetry, configuration backup, and patching tooling before production sign-off
* Produce and maintain as-built documentation, network topology diagrams, low-level designs, runbooks, and knowledge articles for all deployed infrastructure

**Routing, Switching and Networking Protocols**

* Implement and support routing across the estate — BGP and OSPF to a strong standard, static routing, route redistribution, filtering, and path selection
* Design and implement VRF-based segregation and route separation across data center, campus, and WAN environments
* Implement and support switching — VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, vPC, and first-hop redundancy on Cisco IOS and NX-OS platforms
* Implement and support IPSec tunnelling for site-to-site and cloud connectivity, including encryption standards, rekeying, and failover behavior
* Design and implement addressing and subnetting to enterprise standards, maintaining IP address management accuracy as deployments land
* Implement quality of service, multicast, and traffic engineering where application or manufacturing requirements demand it
* Implement network zones, VLANs, and segmentation in line with security architecture and zoning standards, in partnership with the network security team

**Data Centre, SDN and SD-WAN**

* Deploy and support data center fabrics built on Cisco ACI, using Cisco APIC for policy, tenant, and endpoint group configuration, and VXLAN overlays for tenant connectivity
* Deploy and support leaf-spine data center architectures, including fabric expansion, overlay design, and integration with compute and storage connectivity requirements
* Deploy and support SD-WAN across Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN (CloudGenix) and FatPipe platforms, including overlay design, transport independence, application-aware routing policy, and failover behavior
* Coordinate circuit delivery with carriers and service providers, managing lead times, handover testing, and acceptance
* Monitor and manage WAN capacity, latency, and cost, recommending upgrades, re-homing, or transport changes

**Wireless Networking – WLAN**

* Deploy, configure, and support Aruba wireless infrastructure, including controllers, access points, and centralized WLAN management
* Deliver wireless design and validation, including predictive design, site surveys, RF tuning, channel and power planning, and post-deployment validation surveys
* Support wireless authentication integration and guest access in partnership with the network security and identity teams
* Troubleshoot wireless performance, roaming, coverage, and interference issues, including in warehouse, laboratory, and manufacturing environments

**Core Network Services and Load Balancing**

* Deploy and support core network services — DNS, DHCP, IP address management, NTP, and VPN termination points
* Deploy and support load balancing across F5, Array, and AVI platforms, including virtual servers, pools, health monitors, persistence, and SSL offload
* Automate load balancer configuration and application onboarding through platform APIs, so recurring onboarding work is templated rather than hand-built
* Support Zscaler traffic steering from the network side — tunnel and forwarding configuration, proxy routing, and validation of traffic paths to the cloud security platform
* Support application onboarding from a network perspective — connectivity requirements, name resolution, certificates on network and load balancing platforms, firewall rule requests, and traffic flow validation
* Maintain accurate DNS and IP address records as a deployment output rather than an afterthought

**Cloud and Hybrid Networking**

* Deploy and support network infrastructure across AWS and Azure — landing zone networking, virtual networks and VPCs, subnetting, routing, peering, and transit architectures, provisioned and maintained through Terraform
* Implement and support hybrid connectivity between cloud, data centers, and sites, including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, and IPSec VPN, with resilient and tested failover paths
* Implement hybrid and split-horizon DNS resolution across on-premises and cloud estates
* Implement and enforce cloud resource tagging standards for network resources, remediating missing or malformed tags to keep network CIs traceable to their application records
* Support container and Kubernetes network connectivity requirements — ingress, egress, service exposure, and IP address planning — in partnership with platform teams

**Operational Support, Incident and Problem Management**

* Manage Move to Production processes for deployed CIs, ensuring proper handover to operational support teams and that all required GxP documentation is maintained
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for all deployed network CIs, working closely with managed-service partners
* Participate in an on-call rotation, responding to network incidents outside business hours
* Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, packet loss, jitter, and throughput issues using Wireshark and NetScout, in partnership with engineering teams and service providers, driving down mean time to recovery (MTTR)
* Diagnose faults across the network stack — BGP and OSPF convergence and flapping, spanning tree and loop events, duplex and error counters, MTU and fragmentation, asymmetric routing, IPSec tunnel failures, DHCP scope exhaustion, and DNS resolution failures
* Act as technical escalation during Major Incidents, joining technical bridges and providing hands-on recovery and clear technical status updates
* Contribute to Root Cause Analysis for recurring and high-impact issues, raising Problem records and driving corrective and preventive actions to closure
* Maintain high-quality incident resolution notes and knowledge articles to support first-line resolution and data-quality targets

**Change and Release Execution**

* Raise, plan, and execute network changes with complete risk assessment, implementation plans, test evidence, and rollback procedures
* Represent network changes at the Change Advisory Board (CAB), providing technical justification, impact analysis, and dependency detail drawn from CMDB service topology
* Actively reduce change-induced incidents through peer review, automated validation, staged rollout, and disciplined post-implementation verification
* Schedule and coordinate deployment windows with application, business, and vendor stakeholders to minimize disruption, respecting manufacturing production schedules and site constraints

**Observability, Telemetry and AIOps**

* Onboard network CIs into monitoring and observability platforms with meaningful metrics, logs, events, flow data, and synthetic checks
* Implement network telemetry and flow visibility — SNMP, streaming telemetry, and NetFlow or IPFIX — and use NetScout for packet-level and service-level performance visibility, making performance measurable rather than anecdotal
* Define alert thresholds and reduce alert noise so alerts are actionable and correctly routed
* Build operational dashboards providing clear visibility of network health, capacity, circuit performance, wireless quality, and deployment quality
* Support AIOps adoption — anomaly detection, event correlation, service-impact analysis, and predictive insight — including AI-assisted triage of network telemetry using NEXUS and Python tooling

**Capacity, Compliance and Resilience**

* Monitor and manage network capacity, utilization, and performance; forecast growth and recommend scaling, re-architecture, or refresh
* Deploy and operate all network infrastructure in line with enterprise security architecture, hardening baselines, and least-privilege access principles
* Meet patch compliance and vulnerability remediation SLAs across all supported CIs, including Cisco IOS/NX-OS, FortiOS, and Junos software currency, with evidenced closure
* Maintain configuration backup and rapid device recovery capability, and test restoration rather than assuming it
* Configure and support network high availability, redundancy, and failover, and validate that resilience behaves as designed under test
* Maintain audit-ready evidence of configuration and change history for regulated and GxP-relevant environments

**Collaboration, Vendor Coordination and Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Cloud Engineering, and Application and Product teams to ensure operational readiness of new platforms and technologies
* Work closely with the network security team on firewall, WAF, DDoS protection, and VPN requirements, implementing segmentation and access requirements to standard and escalating where a requirement is not operable
* Support site and manufacturing stakeholders on network requirements for production, laboratory, and OT environments, respecting validation and availability constraints
* Coordinate technical delivery governance with managed-service partners and vendors, validating the quality of delivered work against standards and SLAs, and ensuring meaningful, timely measurement of vendor support using KPIs

**Key Performance Indicators**
**Deployment**

* Deployment success rate and lead time, from request to validated production
* Automation coverage — proportion of network infrastructure and configuration deployed via Terraform, Ansible, Python, and API automation rather than manual device configuration
* First-time-right deployment rate; rework and rollback frequency
* Configuration drift rate and time to remediate detected drift
* Golden configuration and software-target compliance across the Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Aruba estate
* DNS and IP address management record accuracy following deployment
* CI data quality at handover — completeness, correctness, non-orphan, and non-stale on newly deployed CIs
* Monitoring, telemetry, configuration backup, and patching onboarding coverage achieved at production sign-off

**Support**

* MTTR for supported network CIs; incident backlog and ageing
* Network availability against service commitments, by site and by service tier
* Change success rate and change-induced incident rate
* Recurring incident rate and Problem closure effectiveness
* Network OS currency across Cisco IOS/NX-OS, FortiOS, and Junos; patch compliance and vulnerability remediation within SLA
* End-of-life device count and reduction trend
* Circuit, WAN, and SD-WAN performance against carrier SLAs, including latency, loss, and availability
* Wireless quality metrics — coverage, client experience, and roaming success
* Capacity headroom on core links and forecast accuracy
* Configuration backup coverage and device recovery test pass rate
* CMDB data-quality KPIs for owned CI classes, including discovery coverage and staleness
* Automation and self-healing adoption; measured manual-effort reduction
* Resolution note quality and knowledge-article contribution

**About You**
**Experience**

* Substantial hands-on experience deploying and supporting enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, data centre, and cloud network infrastructure in large-scale, global, multi-vendor environments
* Demonstrable depth in routing and switching, with working knowledge across wireless, SD-WAN, load balancing, and cloud networking on AWS and Azure
* Practical experience automating network deployment and configuration with Terraform, Ansible, Python, and vendor APIs
* Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory, or OT network environments is an advantage
* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, or comparable — is an advantage

**Technical Skills – Networking Protocols And Routing**

* Strong TCP/IP fundamentals, subnetting, and protocol-level understanding
* BGP and OSPF to a strong standard, including route filtering, redistribution, and path selection
* VRF design and implementation for route separation and multi-tenancy
* IPSec for site-to-site and cloud tunnelling, including encryption standards and failover
* VXLAN overlays and their integration with data centre fabric design
* Switching — VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, vPC, and first-hop redundancy
* Quality of service, multicast, and traffic engineering

**Technical Skills – Data Centre, SDN And SD-WAN**

* Cisco ACI fabric design, deployment, and operation, with hands-on Cisco APIC policy configuration
* Leaf-spine data centre architecture and VXLAN overlay operation
* SD-WAN deployment and support on Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN (CloudGenix) and FatPipe
* WAN transport — MPLS, internet, broadband and cellular backup, and carrier engagement

**Technical Skills – WLAN And Campus**

* Campus LAN design across access, distribution, and core layers on Cisco IOS and NX-OS platforms

**Technical Skills – Load Balancing And Core Services**

* Load balancing on F5, Array, and AVI platforms — virtual servers, pools, monitors, persistence, and SSL offload
* DNS, DHCP, IP address management, and NTP at enterprise scale
* Zscaler traffic forwarding and steering from a network perspective
* Certificates and TLS as applied to network and load balancing platforms

**Technical Skills – Cloud And Hybrid Networking**

* Networking on AWS and Azure — virtual networks and VPCs, subnetting, route tables, peering, transit gateway or virtual WAN, and cloud load balancers
* Terraform for cloud network provisioning — module design, remote state, plan and apply workflow, and drift detection
* Hybrid connectivity — ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, and IPSec VPN, with resilient design
* Hybrid and split-horizon DNS resolution
* Container and Kubernetes networking concepts — ingress, egress, and IP planning
* Cloud tagging and governance standards

**Technical Skills – Network Security Interface**

* Working knowledge of firewalls — Cisco ASA and FTD, Fortinet FortiGate, and Juniper SRX — sufficient to implement to standard and troubleshoot policy-related faults
* Awareness of Web Application Firewall and DDoS protection services and how they affect traffic flow
* Working familiarity with AlgoSec for raising and tracking firewall rule requests and understanding policy impact on planned network changes
* Ability to interpret firewall and security platform logs, including FortiAnalyzer, when isolating whether a fault is network or policy related
* VPN connectivity and remote access from a network perspective
* Understanding of how inspection points, proxies, NAT, and Zscaler forwarding affect traffic flow and application behaviour
* Deep firewall policy administration sits with the network security team; this role partners with them rather than owning that scope

**Automation, Tooling and AI**

* Terraform — infrastructure-as-code provisioning of AWS and Azure network resources, including module design, remote state, and plan review as a change gate
* Ansible — reusable roles, templates, and inventory management for multi-vendor network configuration
* Python — scripting, API consumption, and automated pre- and post-change validation
* Selenium — automation of vendor web consoles and portals that expose no usable API
* NEXUS as an AI agent for configuration review, log and capture triage, documentation drafting, and automation scaffolding
* Platform and controller APIs — Cisco APIC, Junos Space, Prisma SD-WAN, FatPipe, and F5, Array, and AVI
* Version control and change pipelines — Git-based workflow for network configuration
* Operating systems — Cisco IOS and NX-OS, FortiOS, and working command-line competence on Linux and Windows

**Troubleshooting and Diagnostics**

* Wireshark — packet capture and protocol-level analysis, including SPAN and mirror captures
* NetScout — packet-level and service-level performance monitoring and fault isolation
* Flow and telemetry analysis — NetFlow or IPFIX, SNMP, and streaming telemetry
* Structured fault isolation across physical, data link, network, and application layers

**ITSM, CMDB and Observability**

* ServiceNow — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and CMDB/CSDM; Discovery and Service Mapping experience strongly preferred
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, particularly Incident, Problem, and Change Management
* Monitoring and observability platforms covering metrics, logs, flow data, and alert design
* Exposure to AIOps and intelligent-operations use cases

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong ownership mindset — accountable for what you deploy, through to production stability
* Calm, structured, and effective under pressure during major incidents, including when the network is the prime suspect
* Rigorous and detail-oriented, with genuine discipline around change control and documentation
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to diagnose across domain boundaries and prove where a fault is not
* Clear communicator, able to explain technical issues in business terms
* Collaborative and customer-focused, comfortable working across teams, vendors, sites, and time zones
* Willingness to travel to sites for deployment and fault resolution where required
* Automation-first instinct and a continuous-improvement mindset

**Preferred Certifications**

* Routing and switching — Cisco CCNP Enterprise or CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure; Juniper JNCIA or JNCIP
* Data centre and SDN — Cisco CCNP Data Center or Cisco ACI specialisation
* Wireless — Aruba ACMA or ACMP, or CWNA
* Cloud networking — AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or Microsoft AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate)
* Security and SD-WAN — Fortinet NSE, or Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN certification
* Load balancing — F5 certification (101, 201, or 301)
* Automation — HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Cisco DevNet Associate, or Red Hat Ansible Automation
* ITSM — ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional; ServiceNow CSA, CAD, or Discovery/CMDB certification
* Agile — Certified Scrum or Agile certification

**Languages**

* English required; additional languages an advantage

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments

+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
