* Maximize the business value from Sanofi’s Digital Technology and Solutions investments.
* Unleash innovation for our organization, employees, and customers.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Platform Automation Engineering

+ With expertise across routing, switching, WAN, data center, and cloud networking, automation of network provisioning, configuration, validation, compliance, monitoring, and remediation.
+ Design and develop scalable, reusable automation frameworks and services.
+ Automate complex multi-vendor network environments across LAN, WAN, data center, SD-WAN, and cloud.
+ Develop automated workflows for network changes, incident remediation, and lifecycle management.
+ Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual network operations.
+ Develop API-driven workflows and automation services.
+ Establish automation standards, design patterns, coding practices, and reusable modules.
+ Monitor Connectivity platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and automate routine tasks.
+ Maintain CI/CD pipelines, security, and data protection for platform systems.

* Platform Performance Engineering

+ Develop automated network health and compliance checks.
+ Integrate telemetry, monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms into automation workflows.
+ Build event-driven automation and automated remediation capabilities.
+ Leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to improve network troubleshooting and operational efficiency.
+ Evaluate opportunities for predictive analytics and intelligent network operations.
+ Monitoring and analyzing network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement performance tuning strategies
+ Drive Automation & Continuous improvement of Network platform solutioning, specification & design, systems integration, platform lifecycle management, standards, and documentation.
+ Drive process improvements that integrate automation and monitor effectiveness to improve efficiency & service delivery.
+ Conduct regular audits, performance tests, generate reports, and track KPIs for network health to manage resource allocation within the network to meet platform demand.

**About You**

* Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

+ Technology leadership skills along with strong Interpersonal & Problem-Solving skills.
+ An enthusiasm for staying up to date with the very latest updates with Network technology solutions.
+ Ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
+ Strong software engineering mindset.
+ Ability to influence engineering decisions.
+ Strong written and verbal communication.
+ Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
+ Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and scalability.
+ Technical Skills

+ 7+ years of experience in network engineering, with substantial experience in network automation.
+ Strong enterprise networking background with expertise in routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN, and network security.
+ Advanced Python programming experience.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, Git, JSON, and YAML.
+ Experience developing production-grade automation frameworks.
+ Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
+ Experience working with multi-vendor network environments.
+ Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
+ Networking in cloud computing experience (Azure, AWS, & GCP)
+ Familiarity and understanding of tunnelling protocols (vxLAN, GRE, IPSec)
+ Working knowledge of DNS, Tacacs, Radius, DHCP, NetFlow, Syslog, etc.
+ Exposure to SCADA modelled Network and concepts.
+ Vendor (technical) management experience
+ Occasional work outside business hours

title: Lead - Network & Design Engineer (DNS, BIND, Route53)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled Network & DNS Design Engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, governance, automation and L3 support of enterprise DNS, domain management and core network services across cloud, datacentre and corporate environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in DNS technologies including AWS Route53, Microsoft Active Directory-integrated DNS and BIND, with responsibility for ensuring the availability, security and scalability of critical name resolution services supporting both internal users and customer-facing platforms.
  
  
The role requires a strong engineering mindset, a passion for automation, and practical experience applying AI-driven solutions to improve operational efficiency, governance and service reliability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and manage enterprise DNS services across AWS Route53, Microsoft DNS and BIND platforms.
* Own the design and governance of public and private DNS infrastructure, including hosted zones, delegation, forwarding, conditional forwarding and resolver services.
* Manage the organisation's domain portfolio, including registrations, renewals, transfers, security controls and lifecycle governance.
* Design and support DNS services integrated with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), ensuring reliable operation of authentication, Group Policy and Windows-based services.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex DNS, domain and network-related incidents.
* Develop and maintain DNS, domain and network standards, documentation and operational processes.
* Design and implement automation solutions using APIs, scripting and Infrastructure as Code.
* Leverage AI-assisted tooling to improve DNS management, domain governance, change validation, troubleshooting and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security and application teams to deliver resilient and secure services.
* Contribute to the design and support of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing and hybrid-cloud networking solutions.

**Essential skills & experience:**

* Extensive experience with AWS Route53, including public and private hosted zones, delegation and DNS governance.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft DNS running on Active Directory Domain Controllers.
* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.
* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.
* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching and network security principles.
* Experience with DNS/IPAM integration and tooling.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform or similar.
* Experience using APIs and Infrastructure as Code to automate operational processes.
* Experience applying AI technologies to infrastructure management, operational efficiency or service automation.

**Desirable experience:**

* AWS networking and infrastructure services.
* F5 DNS/GTM and load balancing technologies.
* NetBox, SolarWinds, Infoblox or similar IPAM platforms.
* VPN, firewall and cloud networking technologies.
* GitOps and modern infrastructure automation practices.
* Experience supporting large-scale global enterprise environments.

**Key Attributes**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Automation-first mindset.
* Excellent documentation and governance discipline.
* Ability to lead technical standards and best practices.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for innovation and the practical application of AI within infrastructure operations.

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: Network Consulting Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of networking and wireless engineering experience

• Experience supporting medium to large enterprise wireless environments

• Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) experience

• Extensive Cisco 9800 WLAN Controller deployment experience

• Software Defined Access (SDA) deployment experience

• Understanding of SDA underlay, overlay, and VXLAN technologies

• Experience with Fabric Enabled Wireless

• Experience with Fabric-in-a-Box (FIAB)

• Wireless deployment, migration, and optimization experience

Job Description

Insight Global is seeking a Wireless Consulting Engineer for a project supporting a large-scale bank network transformation initiative focused on modernizing wireless infrastructure across a broad portfolio of enterprise locations. This engineer will play a critical role in the design, deployment, migration, optimization, and support of enterprise wireless environments leveraging Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco 9800 Wireless Controllers, Software Defined Access (SDA), RF design, Ekahau wireless surveys, and wireless automation technologies. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical leader, mentor junior engineers, drive implementation activities, review technical deliverables, resolve highly complex wireless and networking issues, and act as a trusted advisor to customer and internal stakeholders. Candidates should be comfortable supporting large-scale multi-site network refresh projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and participating in occasional night and weekend implementation windows

• Lead delivery and execution of enterprise wireless deployment projects supporting Cisco's Project Helium initiative

• Support the modernization of wireless infrastructure across enterprise and distributed customer locations

• Work extensively with customers, Cisco account teams, architects, and partners on deployment strategy and optimization efforts

• Create, review, and approve technical deliverables including HLDs, LLDs, design recommendations, RF designs, and implementation plans

• Configure, deploy, optimize, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco 9800 Controllers, SDA, Fabric Enabled Wireless, and Fabric-in-a-Box solutions

• Perform and review Ekahau predictive wireless surveys and AP placement designs

• Support AP-on-a-Stick validation activities when required

• Serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex customer issues

• Build and leverage test environments to validate solutions and resolve complex networking challenges

• Direct and coordinate onsite technicians during implementation and deployment activities

• Support migration efforts from legacy wireless environments to modern Cisco wireless architectures

• Participate in change control, cutover planning, implementation validation, and post-deployment support

• Mentor junior engineers and provide peer reviews of technical work products

• Contribute to deployment methodologies, automation efforts, scripts, and reusable technical assets

• Deliver customer documentation, knowledge transfers, and technical training

• Track project activities and provide updates through Jira

Ensure all technical deliverables align with customer business objectives, deployment standards, and project goals

title: DCO Tech 3, HYD-Infinity - DCO
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advanced data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
   

  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift \& rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation


**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
**IT Disaster Recovery Manager**
**Experience** 
 : 8 to 12 Years
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a skilled and proactive IT Disaster Recovery (DR) Manager with 8–12 years of experience in IT infrastructure resilience and recovery planning. The ideal candidate will also have hands\-on experience in Planning and executing Disaster Recovery Exercies. This role ensures the organization's critical IT systems can recover rapidly and effectively in the event of an outage or disaster.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Primary roles and responsibilities:**
* Develop, implement, and maintain IT Disaster Recovery strategies, plans, and runbooks for critical systems and application services.
* Conduct regular risk assessments and business impact analyses (BIA) to identify recovery priorities.
* Coordinate and lead Disaster Recovery exercises, failover testing, and tabletop exercises.
* Work closely with application, infrastructure, and business teams to validate various recovery time objectives.
* Maintain documentation for DR procedures, policies, and communication plans.
* Monitor compliance with DR policies and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with vendors and cloud service providers for offsite DR solutions.
* Strong reporting and documentation skills to help develop materials on the action plans and provide status updates to senior leadership on the risks and dependencies associated with the action plans.
* Strong stakeholder management skills for international clients primarily based out of US and UK locations including prior experience in managing clients based out of the mentioned locations.


**Additional roles and responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with SMEs during DR drills to validate failover and integrity checks.
* Ensure alignment of database high availability (HA) and DR strategies.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalant in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience working at GSIB Bank (Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citibank, etc.
* 8–12 years of hands\-on experience in IT Disaster Recovery planning and testing.
* Exposure to industry frameworks such as ISO 22301, NIST SP 800\-34 etc.
* Certification preferred: CDRE, CBCP etc.
* Experience with DR tools and platforms (e.g., Veeam, Zerto, SRM, Commvault, Azure Site Recovery, etc.).
* Familiarity with backup and replication technologies.
* Experience in any of the Database technology i.e. Oracle, MSSql or MySQL.
* Understanding of virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V) and cloud DR strategies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Strong documentation and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and cross\-functionally.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CBCP, CDRE, Microsoft/AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Manager - Network Operations
description:
Technical Lead \- Network Operations
   

  

 Hands\-on technical lead responsible for
 **advanced troubleshooting oversight,** 
 design , engineering
 **and strategic evolution with 12\+ years of experience in** 
 enterprise network across on\-prem, cloud, and contact center ecosystems. infrastructure lifecycle management, and country\-specific compliance requirements. This role acts as the primary escalation point for Hyderabad office network operations while closely partnering with Home Office infrastructure and security teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and oversee Hyderabad office network operations and support activities.
* Manage and mentor local network team members and provide technical guidance/escalation support.


**Advanced Incident Resolution \& Escalation Ownership**
* Act as the primary escalation point for all network\-related incidents, outages, and operational issues.
* Lead resolution of critical P1/P2 network incidents
* Provide deep\-dive troubleshooting across:
+ Network (routing, switching, load balancing)
+ Cloud connectivity
+ Voice/contact center flows

* Perform packet\-level and call trace analysis
* Own final RCA and prevent recurrence through design/automation improvements


**Network Performance \& Upgrades**
* Monitor enterprise network for connectivity issues, performance degradation, and service interruptions.
* Coordinate with appropriate internal teams and vendors for issue resolution.
* Ensure timely incident response, communication, RCA, and closure.
* Manage on\-premises network infrastructure including:
+ Switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and hub room maintenance.
+ Network hardware lifecycle activities include upgrades, refreshes, and replacements.


* Design and optimize:
+ Contribute to design and optimization activities in collaboration with Home Office teams:
+ Enterprise Networks (LAN/WAN, DC, Cloud) while aligning with global standards and architecture direction.
+ Hybrid cloud connectivity (Azure/AWS, VPN//ExpressRoute/Direct Connect) with active participation in planning, implementation and optimization discussions.


**Cloud Networking \& Hybrid Connectivity**
* AWS networking (VPCs, Transit Gateway)
* On\-prem ↔ cloud connectivity


**Load Balancing \& Traffic Engineering**
* Manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM concepts)
* Application delivery optimization


**Automation \& Observability**
* Develop automations for Incident response, Network validation \& Configuration management
* Enhance Monitoring (alerts, thresholds, dashboards), Observability (log/trace correlation)
* Drive MTTR reduction and predictive operations

* ISPs / circuits
* Voice providers
* OEMs (Cisco, F5, etc.)

* Work closely with firewall/security teams on major incidents, network changes, and security remediation activities.
* Support and coordinate network\-related activities across both on\-premises and cloud environments.
* Provide oversight for Hyderabad Voice Operations team activities; no deep hands\-on voice administration required but expected to coordinate and drive operational accountability.
* Coordinate with Home Office teams on global initiatives, network standards, implementation plans, and operational improvements.
* Participate in major incident management calls and drive network\-related troubleshooting and resolution activities.
* Review and maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and operational knowledge base articles.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve MTTR and reduce recurring incidents.
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, and operational processes are aligned with enterprise standards.

* Deep expertise in TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, routing and switching.
* BGP and OSPF (design, troubleshooting) knowledge.
* Structured troubleshooting including packet capture analysis.
* Network flow diagnostics
* Understanding of load balancers (F5 preferred).
* Experience managing enterprise office network infrastructure and vendor coordination.
* Experience handling network escalations, RCA discussions, and major incident management.
* Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Basic understanding of voice concepts including SIP/RTP, QoS, and call flows.
* Experience with ServiceNow platform for incident/change/problem management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with ability to work across global teams and time zones.
* Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, RCA reports, and operational runbooks.
* Ability to lead small operational teams and coordinate cross\-functional activities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cisco and Arista platforms including CVaS.
* Exposure to enterprise firewall/security operations and coordination with security teams.
* Experience managing ISP/vendor relationships and telecom escalations.
* Experience with monitoring and network management tools.
* Familiarity with Confluence, Lucid chart, and Visio.
* Prior experience in enterprise contact center or voice operations environments.

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).

description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
 EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.
   

  

 We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.
   

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
 We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Audiovisual Engineering team. This technical role supports the global AV ecosystem that powers seamless communication and collaboration across the company. You’ll be responsible for the implementation, support, administration, and life cycle management of audio/video hardware and software, focusing not only on reliability, but also on automation, scripting, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with commercial AV technologies (QSC Q\-SYS, Shure, Dante), video conferencing systems (Google Meet, Zoom), and converged IP networks, paired with a strong foundation in automation tools, programming, and infrastructure as code. You’ll play a key role in driving innovation, improving support processes, and building repeatable solutions that reduce manual overhead. This position involves full lifecycle project ownership—from requirements gathering and design reviews through deployment and operational support—and may require occasional off\-hours work.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
* Own the implementation and support of AV technologies for deployment projects globally.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, and AV integrators to design, automate, and deploy solutions that align with company standards.
* Develop and manage scripts, tools, and automation pipelines for provisioning and managing AV systems.
* Analyze, test, install, document, and support audio/video over IP solutions in a global, converged network environment.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support AV operations and upgrades in production.
* Produce scopes of work, documentation (including AV schematics), and vendor communications for new AV installations or retrofits.
* Identify and recommend new technologies or automation strategies to improve scalability and efficiency.
* Maintain detailed documentation of deployed AV configurations, including change history and versioning.
* Lead or assist in root cause analysis and long\-term resolution of AV issues; mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting and automation techniques.
* Develop and manage project timelines, resource estimates, and product refresh schedules.
* Serve as Tier 3 support for complex AV issues and escalations in production environments.
* Travel up to 20% for deployments, testing, and operational support.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* QSC Q\-SYS certification, strong remote support experience
* 4\+ years in a corporate IT or AV integration environment, with at least 3 years working directly with commercial AV systems.
* Proficient in supporting video conferencing platforms such as Google Meet, Zoom, Logitech, and Neat.
* Programming and automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible, PowerShell) to build tools and automate repetitive AV tasks.
* Strong understanding of AV over IP technologies and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with AV control system logic and user interface design is a plus.
* Comfortable adapting to change and working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Skilled in breaking down complex issues into actionable solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; capable of translating technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Self\-starter with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bonus: Experience supporting live production events or hybrid broadcast\-style setups.

title: ADMS Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post\-sales lifecycle – from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – working directly with customers and with cross\-functional GE Vernova teams.
   

  

 This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer\-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery Ownership
+ Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed\-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
+ Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle – requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
+ Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
+ Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
+ Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.

* Client Collaboration
+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
+ Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
+ Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
+ Ensure go\-live readiness and provide support, including post\-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
+ Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on\-site presence during testing, cutover and go\-live windows.

* Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support
+ Provide hands\-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed\-base customers.
+ Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re\-verification and migration activities.
+ Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.

* Leadership and Mentorship
+ Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
+ Ability to work across all GEV silos – Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners – with a OneTeam mentality.
+ Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
+ Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

* Best Practice and Quality Assurance
+ Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
+ Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
+ Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.

* Decision\-Making and Problem Solving
+ Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
+ Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
+ Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.

* Market Awareness and Integration
+ Possess in\-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
+ Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience implementing, upgrading or supporting ADMS / DMS / OMS / SCADA solutions for electric utilities, with significant hands\-on experience on GE Vernova ADMS Series 3\.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on utility software projects, including direct customer\-facing responsibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across MENAT and APAC as required by project phase.
* Based in Hyderabad, India, and aligned with HTC workplace guidelines.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Masters degree in electrical engineering / Power systems
* Deep experience with distribution network model (DNAF) build, validation, migration and data quality management.
* Experience with OMS / Enterprise OMS, Habitat / SCADA, eFEP and ADMS integrations (GIS, CIS, AMI, IVR, SCADA).
* Experience with ADMS Series 3 version upgrades and installed\-base support.
* Exposure to the GridOS platform is a plus.
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones with regional customers and distributed GE Vernova teams.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Encryption Agility Engineer
description:
**Role Name: Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer**
**Job Posting Title:** 
 Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer
   

  

**Department Name:** 
 Trusted Core Technologies
   

  

**About Amgen**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Description:**
 The Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer will serve as a senior hands\-on engineer for Amgen's enterprise Encryption Agility Service for Post\-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness Preparation. This role supports the Senior Manager Information Security \- Encryption Agility Service Lead and the Senior Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Team Architect by executing the technical work needed to build and operate Amgen's enterprise cryptographic inventory, discovery workflows, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), remediation tracking, and engineering guidance for encryption, cryptography, crypto agility, and post\-quantum readiness. The role is expected to be practical, technical, and service\-oriented, with the ability to analyze cryptographic findings across applications, cloud, infrastructure, identity, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificates, Key Management Services (KMS), secrets, data protection, Software as a Service (SaaS), and third\-party ecosystems.
   

  

 This position will translate architecture direction into working implementation tasks, data quality rules, dashboards, tool integrations, remediation tickets, secure patterns, developer guidance, and repeatable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The engineer will partner with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), PKI and certificate service owners, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, cloud, infrastructure, platform, Risk and Compliance, Procurement, Legal, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Operational Technology (OT), and vendor teams to help make Amgen's PQC roadmap measurable, actionable, and sustainable.
   

  

 The role is also expected to identify high\-volume, human\-intensive Encryption Agility Service processes and design Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled orchestration patterns that reduce manual work, improve analysis speed, increase team throughput, and strengthen service consistency. This includes the ability to architect AI agents or coordinated teams of AI agents that support cryptographic inventory analysis, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data quality, remediation tracking, reporting, evidence review, and governance workflows while maintaining human\-in\-the\-loop decision points for risk acceptance, exception handling, production change decisions, and other activities requiring accountable human judgment.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Technical Delivery**

* Build intelligent workflows integrating network automation with ITSM, monitoring, and observability platforms
* Implement network testing and validation frameworks ensuring changes are verified pre\-production
* Create automated documentation systems that maintain accuracy through code\-driven processes
* Design disaster recovery and rollback mechanisms for all automated changes
* Develop telemetry collection and analytics pipelines for network insights and predictive automation


**Collaboration \& Enablement**
* Partner with Network Architecture to embed automation into design standards and reference architectures
* Collaborate with Security to ensure automated compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements
* Work with Cloud and DevOps teams to integrate network automation with broader infrastructure automation initiatives
* Mentor and upskill network engineers on automation principles, scripting, and platform usage
* Establish communities of practice and knowledge\-sharing forums for automation excellence


**Operational Excellence**
* Provide Level 3/4 escalation support for complex automation platform and workflow issues
* Establish operational runbooks and playbooks for automation platform management
* Implement monitoring and alerting for automation infrastructure and job execution
* Conduct regular platform health assessments and optimization activities


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 7\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience in enterprise environments
* 3\+ years of demonstrated experience designing and implementing network automation solutions at scale
* Proven track record of greenfield automation platform implementation and organizational adoption


**Additional Skills That Would Be Beneficial**
**Core Automation \& Orchestration:**

* Advanced skills in Python for network automation (libraries: Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, TextFSM)

**Network Technologies**
* Deep understanding of enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, VRFs)

**What We Offer**

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: IT&D Senior Manager, Connectivity Services
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager – Connectivity Services to lead the global strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise connectivity and network security services. This role is responsible for designing and governing next\-generation networking and security platforms including SD\-WAN, SASE/SSE (Zscaler ZIA \& ZPA), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Palo Alto Next\-Generation Firewall environments across enterprise, cloud, IT/OT, and industrial networks. The role will drive secure, scalable, and highly resilient connectivity across global operations while enabling digital transformation, cloud adoption, and IT/OT convergence. It requires strong leadership in architecture governance, service reliability, cybersecurity integration, vendor management, and operational excellence across complex multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own global connectivity and network security strategy aligned with digital, cloud, and IT/OT transformation roadmap.
* Lead enterprise architecture for SD\-WAN, SASE/SSE (Zscaler ZIA \& ZPA), ZTNA, hybrid Cloud networking, and secure connectivity services.
* Develop multi\-year roadmap for network modernization, security convergence, and IT/OT evolution.
* Establish and govern global standards, reference architectures, and security design principles for connectivity services.
* Own and manage SD\-WAN (Silver Peak), global internet breakout, and VPN replacement strategies.
* Architect and manage Palo Alto NGFW environments including IT/OT zones, iDMZ, B2B VPN, and cloud security integration.
* Manage firewall ecosystems including Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), and Strata Logging Service (SLS).
* Ensure consistent enforcement of security policies across internet, SaaS, cloud, and


 enterprise applications.
   

  

* Lead IT/OT convergence strategy including industrial segmentation, secure connectivity, iDMZ, and IoT/OT device security.
* Implement Zero Trust principles including identity\-based access, least privilege, and secure segmentation across networks.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, and performance of global connectivity and security platforms.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex


 network/security issues.
   

  

* Drive automation, orchestration, and AIOps adoption across connectivity and security operations.
* Maintain architecture documentation, governance standards, and operational reporting for leadership. IT\&D Senior Manager, Connectivity Services
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement firewall policies, threat prevention, encryption, and secure access controls.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security frameworks, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Manage vulnerability remediation and continuous security posture improvements.
* Lead vendor management and governance for Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, SD\-WAN providers, ISPs, and managed service partners.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, manufacturing, and business stakeholders for solution delivery.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies such as AI\-driven security, SASE evolution, IoT security, and edge computing.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in enterprise networking, network security, or infrastructure architecture roles, with significant leadership exposure.
* Strong hands\-on and architectural expertise in SD\-WAN (preferably Silver Peak), SASE, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
* Extensive experience with Zscaler SSE platforms including ZIA (Internet Access) and ZPA (Private Access).
* Deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), and Strata Logging Service (SLS).
* Strong understanding of enterprise network design including WAN, internet breakout, B2B VPN, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Proven experience in IT/OT convergence, industrial network segmentation, and iDMZ architecture.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles including Zero Trust, least privilege access, and network segmentation.
* Experience managing large\-scale, global, multi\-vendor network and security ecosystems.
* Strong experience in service governance, incident management, and operational excellence in enterprise environments.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills with ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
* Strong ability to drive transformation, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement in complex global environments.


 The skills for success
   

  

 SD\-WAN (Silver Peak), Zscaler (ZIA \& ZPA), SASE / SSE, Zero Trust (ZTNA), Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama / Strata tools, Enterprise networking (WAN/LAN), Cloud networking (AWS/Azure), IT/OT networks \& iDMZ, Network security (segmentation, encryption), Global network architecture, Vendor management, Incident management (L3/L4\), Architecture governance, Automation / AIOps, Hybrid cloud connectivity, Internet breakout strategy, B2B VPN, Firewall policy management, Threat prevention technologies, Network performance optimization, High availability \& resiliency design, Multi\-vendor environment management, Infrastructure security, Digital transformation programs
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: NOC Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
 CTS is seeking a hands\-on Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager to build and operate a centralized, global 24x7 NOC based in Hyderabad, India. This role reports to the VP of Operations and is accountable for establishing the people, processes, and performance required to support more than 50 global customer programs delivering transit fare collection and payment card processing services.
   

  

 The NOC Manager will lead a team of approximately 40–60 Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC analysts operating around the clock, with defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional field services teams. The role requires prior experience building or significantly maturing a 24x7 operations center and enforcing disciplined, repeatable operational practices aligned with ITIL 4, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS v4 operational monitoring expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This is a build\-and\-operate leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end NOC effectiveness, including:
   

  

* Build and lead a centralized Hyderabad\-based NOC organization (40–60 staff) with Tier 1 and Tier 2 roles and defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional operations.
* Design and manage 24x7 shift coverage, staffing models, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and operate 24x7 monitoring and event management for networks, systems, cloud services, applications, and OT/edge devices supporting transit payments.
* Implement and enforce ITIL\-aligned Incident Management, including triage, severity assignment, escalation, major incident coordination, communications, and post\-incident review.
* Ensure continuous verification of operational controls including log management, monitoring coverage, backup success, recovery testing, change control discipline, and DR readiness.
* Ensure NOC operations support PCI DSS v4 monitoring requirements and are executed in a manner consistent with ISO 27001 operational control and evidence expectations.
* Lead operational response to emergent incidents, ensuring rapid containment, service restoration, and accurate executive and stakeholder communications.
* Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and shift handover standards.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences; drive continual improvement through trend analysis and postmortems.
* Coordinate closely with Security Operations (SOC) for escalation of operational anomalies with potential security implications.


**Essential Job Duties**
* Operate a 24x7 NOC covering monitoring, performance and capacity management, incident management, logging, change coordination, backup verification, and DR readiness.
* Ensure rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of outages and degradations affecting customer\-facing payment and transit services.
* Lead major incident bridges and enforce structured communication and restoration validation.
* Ensure logging, monitoring, and telemetry failures are treated as operational risks and remediated with urgency.
* Produce and maintain incident records, reports, and operational evidence suitable for audit and compliance review.


 General Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Operate effectively under limited supervision in a high\-availability, mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and consistency in process execution and documentation.
* Communicate effectively in English, including written incident updates and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Motivate and lead teams across multiple shifts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Escalate issues appropriately while maintaining productive working relationships.
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to motivate activity to meet the needs, and adept at escalating in an effective manner that preserves relations.
* Able to reliably demonstrate ethical behavior and accurate communications even when complex factors are involved.
* Able to operate in a professional manner, even in crisis settings.
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures


**Essential**
 Skills / Experience / Knowledge
   

  

* Proven experience building and leading a 24x7 NOC or equivalent mission\-critical operations organization.
* Strong command of monitoring \& event management and incident management, including major incident leadership.
* Experience operating hybrid environments including customer\-site data centers and Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated operational ownership of log management, backup verification, change/configuration control, and DR readiness.
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong audit and evidence requirements (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC, etc.).
* Establishes operational objectives, policies, procedures and work plans and delegates assignments to subordinates. Develops, modifies and executes company policies that affect immediate operations and may also have company\-wide effect. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment.
* Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and may lack strategic direction. Implements policies and selects methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.
* Interacts regularly with lower and/or senior management on matters concerning multiple functional areas, department, and/or customers. Requires the ability to persuade others in sensitive complex situations while preserving relationships. Applies knowledge to convince other stakeholders on desired departmental outcomes.
* This position must be able to create networks involving coordination among groups and provide thought leadership to pursue organization projects. This will require understanding of wider business and conveying advanced information and persuading several diverse stakeholders or audiences. The position must be recognized internally as a subject matter expert and will direct the activities of others.
* Demonstrated competency in strategic thinking and leadership with strong abilities in relationship management


 Desirable
   

  

* Experienced in operations supporting payments or high\-volume transaction processing operations experience.
* Experience monitoring Operational Technology (OT) or distributed edge device ecosystems.
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent operational practice experience.


**Qualifications**
 Essential
   

  

* 12\-15\+ years of experience in mission\-critical IT or service operations, including people leadership in a 24x7 model.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


 Desirable
   

  

* Formal ITIL, ISO 27001, or operations management certifications.

**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
   

  

 Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
   

  

 Senior Network Engineer – GPU Cluster Networking
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join the AMD IT System Engineering team.
   

  

 This role is responsible for the architecture, deployment, optimization, automation, and production operation of high\-performance backend networks supporting large\-scale AMD GPU clusters. The engineer will own the network path from the GPU server and NIC through the data center switching fabric, ensuring that distributed AI training, large language model, inference, and HPC workloads receive predictable bandwidth, low latency, and reliable collective communication performance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have experience designing, scaling, and operating backend network infrastructure for GPU clusters with approximately 10,000 or more GPUs, or comparable hyperscale AI and HPC environments.
   

  

 The primary focus of this position is high\-speed Ethernet and RoCEv2 networking for AMD Instinct accelerator clusters. You will work across switches, NICs, optics, RDMA, Linux networking, PCIe and NUMA topology, ROCm, RCCL, SLURM, Kubernetes, storage networks, automation platforms, and observability systems.
   

  

 You will partner with AMD AI engineering, network engineering, data center, storage, security, platform, and application teams to ensure the backend network fabric is not a bottleneck to GPU workload performance.
   

  

**The Person**
 You are a highly experienced, hands\-on network engineer with deep expertise in data center networking, RDMA, RoCEv2, and large\-scale GPU cluster fabrics with approximately 10,000 or more GPUs,.
   

  

 You understand how distributed GPU workloads generate traffic across the backend network and how application performance is affected by network topology, congestion, GPU\-to\-NIC locality, routing, switch buffering, traffic\-class configuration, and collective communication patterns. You take responsibility for end\-to\-end outcomes, including architecture, implementation, qualification, production deployment, monitoring, incident response, capacity planning, and continuous improvement. You use telemetry and repeatable performance testing to validate designs and make data\-driven engineering decisions.
   

  

 You are comfortable leading complex technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, documenting architecture and operating standards, and working across globally distributed organizations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, deploy, operate, and continuously improve high\-performance backend networks for large\-scale AMD Instinct GPU clusters.
* Design network fabrics capable of supporting AI and HPC environments ranging from individual GPU racks to clusters containing 10,000 or more GPUs.
* Own the backend network architecture from the GPU server and network interface card through the leaf\-spine switching fabric.
* Design and optimize high\-speed Ethernet fabrics using RoCEv2 and 100/200/400 GbE technologies.
* Develop scalable network topologies, including leaf\-spine, Clos, fat\-tree, rail\-optimized, multi\-plane, and non\-blocking fabric architectures.
* Perform network topology modeling, oversubscription analysis, traffic\-flow analysis, bandwidth planning, port\-capacity planning, failure\-domain analysis, and long\-term growth forecasting.
+ Configure, tune, validate, and troubleshoot lossless or near\-lossless RoCEv2 environments, including PFC, ECN, DCQCN, QoS, ECMP, Switch buffer and queue management, DSCP and priority mappings

* Design and operate routing and switching environments using technologies such as BGP, ECMP, VLAN, VRF, EVPN, and VXLAN.
* Optimize end\-to\-end communication performance across GPUs, NICs, switches, CPUs, PCIe devices, storage systems, and the Linux networking stack.
* Lead production incident response, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive engineering improvements for GPU cluster networks.
* Plan and execute network expansions, cluster scale\-outs, switch replacements, capacity upgrades, and fabric migrations


**Preferred Experience**
* Significant experience designing, deploying, and operating production data center networks for AI, GPU, HPC, cloud, or other large\-scale distributed computing environments.
* Experience designing, scaling, or operating backend network infrastructure for GPU clusters containing approximately 10,000 or more GPUs, or similarly sized hyperscale compute environments.
* Deep knowledge of data center networking fundamentals; Routing and switching, VLANs and subnetting, BGP and ECMP, Quality of Service, MTU configuration, Switch buffering, Network segmentation
* Strong hands\-on experience with RDMA and RoCEv2 in production environments.
* Demonstrated experience configuring, tuning, and troubleshooting PFC, ECN, DCQCN, QoS, switch buffers, NIC queues, RDMA traffic classes, and lossless or near\-lossless Ethernet.
* Strong understanding of leaf\-spine, Clos, fat\-tree, rail\-optimized, and multi\-plane network architectures.
* Experience with network routing technologies such as BGP and ECMP and overlay technologies such as EVPN and VXLAN.
* Strong understanding of GPU cluster topology, including GPU\-to\-GPU, GPU\-to\-NIC, CPU\-to\-NIC, PCIe, NUMA, and network locality.
* Experience building monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, streaming telemetry, gNMI, SNMP, sFlow, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with Juniper data center switching platforms and Junos OS, including configuration and troubleshooting
* Experience with AMD Instinct accelerators, ROCm, RCCL, and AMD GPU software environments.
* Experience with AMD Pensando AI NICs, SmartNICs, DPUs, or other AMD Pensando networking technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Juniper data center switching platforms and Junos OS, including configuration and troubleshooting
* Experience designing backend networks specifically for large language model training and other communication\-intensive distributed AI workloads.
* Experience with Ethernet fabric technologies such as BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, and modern leaf\-spine data center architectures.


**Academic Creditals**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**LOCATION:**
